二维 RANS–SA 方程的离散伴随：格心格式，伴随一致的远场

Discrete adjoints for two-dimensional RANS–SA: cell-centred, adjoint-consistent far field

算例是二维对流页面的同一张环形混合网格：内圈是物面，外圈是远场，贴壁一层四边形、外层三角形。方程换成可压缩 RANS 与标准 Spalart–Allmaras 湍流模型：每个单元有 5 个未知量 (ρ, ρu, ρv, ρE, ρν̃)。物面是无滑移、绝热壁面（弱条件，写在壁面面的通量里），远场分成来流与出口两部分：来流给定 ρ、u、v、ν̃（T 自由、热流为零），出口是牵引力出口（总牵引力 p n − τ·n 等于 p∞n）。空间离散：Roe 通量、无权最小二乘重构（不加限制器）、SU2 式的边上修正平均梯度粘性通量；求解：伪时间 + 对称块 Gauss–Seidel，近似 Jacobian 是一阶 Roe 加薄剪切层。本页的主线是离散伴随：先把残差拆成几遍循环，再把同样的循环改写成 matrix-free 前向（R˙=AU˙）和 matrix-free 伴随（Uˉ=ATRˉ），最后用前向、复数步长与差分三种独立办法核对伴随给出的导数。附录 A 从同一个连续问题出发推导并求解连续伴随，在逐级加密的网格上与离散伴随比较。本页的来流边界是伴随一致的：加密时离散伴随连来流边界附近也趋于连续伴随。附录 B 说明做法，并与原来的处理逐级比较。页首可以切换一阶／二阶空间离散，下面所有演示都随之重算。相关页面：同一问题的格点版本只换了控制体；本系列的一维 Burgers 入门从最简单的方程讲离散伴随的整套做法（残差、matrix-free 前向与伴随、Gauss–Seidel、差分与复数步长），二维 Euler 在同一张网格上处理无粘方程组（它用 Rusanov 通量，本页换成 Roe 通量），二维层流 Navier–Stokes 加上粘性通量与无滑移壁（它的梯度重构与粘性通量离散和本页不同）。

The test case is the same annular hybrid mesh as the two-dimensional advection pages: the body on the inner ring, the far field on the outer, quadrilaterals in the layer against the wall and triangles outside. The equations become compressible RANS with the standard Spalart–Allmaras model: every cell carries 5 unknowns (ρ, ρu, ρv, ρE, ρν̃). The body is a no-slip, adiabatic wall (a weak condition, written into the wall face's flux), and the far field has two parts: the inflow fixes ρ, u, v and ν̃ (T is free, with zero heat flux), and the outlet is a traction outlet (the total traction p n − τ·n equals p∞n). Spatial discretisation: the Roe flux, unweighted least-squares reconstruction (no limiter), and SU2's corrected average gradient on the edges for the viscous flux; the solver: pseudo-time with symmetric block Gauss–Seidel, on an approximate Jacobian made of first-order Roe and the thin shear layer. The main line of this page is the discrete adjoint: it splits the residual into passes, rewrites the same passes as the matrix-free tangent (R˙=AU˙) and the matrix-free adjoint (Uˉ=ATRˉ), and checks the adjoint's derivatives three independent ways: the tangent, the complex step, and finite differences. Appendix A derives and solves the continuous adjoint of the same continuous problem and compares it with the discrete adjoint on a sequence of refined meshes. This page treats the inflow boundary in an adjoint-consistent way: under refinement the discrete adjoint approaches the continuous one near the inflow as well. Appendix B explains how, and compares level by level with the original treatment. The header switches between first- and second-order spatial discretisation, and every demo below is recomputed. Related pages: the node-centred version of the same problem changes the control volumes only; in this series, the 1-D Burgers introduction walks through the whole discrete-adjoint method on the simplest equation (residual, matrix-free tangent and adjoint, Gauss–Seidel, finite differences and the complex step), 2-D Euler treats the inviscid system on this same mesh (with a Rusanov flux, where this page uses Roe's), and 2-D laminar Navier–Stokes adds the viscous flux and the no-slip wall (with a gradient reconstruction and a viscous discretisation different from this page's).

第 1 节Section 1

网格：单元、面与壁面距离

Mesh: cells, faces and wall distance

网格与二维对流页面完全相同，编号也相同：节点逐圈从壁面向外，单元逐圈编号，面按“内部、壁面、远场”排序。未知量放在单元里：24 个单元就是 24 个控制体。区别在于每个控制体现在有 5 个未知量，而不是 1 个。

The mesh is exactly that of the two-dimensional advection page, with the same numbering: nodes ring by ring from the wall outwards, cells ring by ring, faces sorted interior, wall, far field. The unknowns live in the cells: the 24 cells are the 24 control volumes. The difference is that every control volume now carries 5 unknowns instead of 1.

一个面循环要读的几何量都画在下图里。和标量页面相比多了两样：从控制体中心 xi 到面点 xf 的重构方向 xf − xi（二阶格式沿它把中心值外推到面上），与两侧中心的连线 Δx = xR − xL（粘性通量沿它取两点差分）。

The geometric quantities a face loop reads are all in the figure below. Compared with the scalar pages there are two more: the reconstruction direction xf − xi from a control-volume centre xi to the face point xf (the second-order scheme extrapolates the centre value along it), and the line Δx = xR − xL between the two centres (the viscous flux takes its two-point difference along it).

壁面距离

The wall distance

SA 模型的耗散项与 (ν̃/d)² 成正比，d 是到壁面的距离。本页的 di 是控制体中心到离散壁面多边形的精确欧氏距离：对每条壁面边求点到线段的距离，取最小。它是坐标的函数，所以在第 11 节的几何导数里也要求导。

The SA model's destruction term goes as (ν̃/d)², with d the distance to the wall. On this page di is the exact Euclidean distance from the control-volume centre to the discrete wall polygon: the distance from the point to each wall edge, and the smallest. It is a function of the coordinates, so the geometric derivatives of Section 11 differentiate it too.

逐步推导：壁面距离与它对坐标的导数

Step by step: the wall distance and its derivative with respect to the coordinates

第 11 节的几何导数要用到 ∂di/∂X。di 是分段定义的：最近点可能落在一条壁面边的内部，也可能落在顶点上。先把它写成显式公式，再逐项求导。记控制体中心为 xi，一条壁面边从壁面节点 Xa 到 Xb，e = Xb − Xa。

The geometric derivatives of Section 11 need ∂di/∂X. di is defined piecewise: the nearest point may lie inside a wall edge or at a vertex. Write it as an explicit formula first, then differentiate term by term. Let xi be the control-volume centre and let a wall edge run from the wall node Xa to Xb, with e = Xb − Xa.

第一步，直线上的最近点。直线上的点是 Xa + ξe；到 xi 的距离平方对 ξ 求导并令其为零：

Step 1, the nearest point on the line. The points of the line are Xa + ξe; differentiate the squared distance to xi with respect to ξ and set it to zero:

ddξ ∣xi−Xa−ξe∣2=−2 e⋅(xi−Xa−ξe)=0⟹ξ∗=(xi−Xa)⋅ee⋅e

第二步，截到线段上。ξ* ≤ 0 时最近点是顶点 Xa，ξ* ≥ 1 时是 Xb，否则是垂足。记截断后的参数 ξ = min(max(ξ*, 0), 1)，最近点 xw = Xa + ξe，距离与它的单位方向是

Step 2, clamp to the segment. For ξ* ≤ 0 the nearest point is the vertex Xa, for ξ* ≥ 1 it is Xb, and otherwise the foot of the perpendicular. With the clamped parameter ξ = min(max(ξ*, 0), 1) the nearest point is xw = Xa + ξe, and the distance and its unit direction are

d=∣xi−xw∣,nw=xi−xwd

di 取所有壁面边中最小的那个（mesh.js 的 segDist 与 geometry 正是这样算的，分支都按实数值选）。

di is the smallest over all wall edges (mesh.js segDist and geometry compute exactly this, every branch chosen on real values).

第三步，垂足情形求导。d² = |xi − Xa − ξe|²，而 ξ = ξ*(xi, Xa, Xb) 本身也随坐标变。但 ξ* 使这个距离平方取极小，∂(d²)/∂ξ = 0：ξ 的变化对 d 没有一阶影响（包络定理）。所以只对显式出现的三个点求前向导数（图 1.4 (a)）：

Step 3, differentiate in the foot case. d² = |xi − Xa − ξe|², and ξ = ξ*(xi, Xa, Xb) moves with the coordinates as well. But ξ* minimises this squared distance, so ∂(d²)/∂ξ = 0: a change of ξ has no first-order effect on d (the envelope theorem). Only the three points that appear explicitly are differentiated, in forward mode (Figure 1.4 (a)):

2d d˙=2 (xi−xw)⋅(x˙i−X˙a−ξ (X˙b−X˙a))⟹∂d∂xi=nw,∂d∂Xa=−(1−ξ) nw,∂d∂Xb=−ξ nw

nw 与 e 垂直，所以沿壁面边移动 Xa 或 Xb 不改变 d；三个导数之和为零，整体平移不改变 d。

nw is perpendicular to e, so moving Xa or Xb along the edge leaves d unchanged; the three derivatives sum to zero, and a rigid translation does not change d.

第四步，顶点情形。ξ* ≤ 0 时 d = |xi − Xa|，直接求导得 ∂d/∂xi = nw、∂d/∂Xa = −nw、∂d/∂Xb = 0：正是第三步的公式取 ξ = 0（ξ* ≥ 1 时取 ξ = 1）。一个公式覆盖两种情形；在 ξ* = 0 处两边的值与导数都相同，所以最近点从顶点滑进边内时，d 的导数不跳。

Step 4, the vertex case. For ξ* ≤ 0, d = |xi − Xa|, and direct differentiation gives ∂d/∂xi = nw, ∂d/∂Xa = −nw, ∂d/∂Xb = 0: Step 3's formula with ξ = 0 (and ξ = 1 for ξ* ≥ 1). One formula covers both cases; at ξ* = 0 both sides have the same value and the same derivative, so the derivative of d does not jump when the nearest point slides from the vertex into the edge.

第五步，回到节点坐标。格心页的中心是单元顶点的平均，xi = (1/k)ΣnXn，所以 ∂di/∂xi = nw 平分给单元的 k 个顶点，每个 nw/k；Xa、Xb 是壁面节点，各得到第三步的一项。

Step 5, back to the node coordinates. On the cell page the centre is the average of the cell's vertices, xi = (1/k)ΣnXn, so ∂di/∂xi = nw is shared equally by the cell's k vertices, nw/k each; Xa and Xb are wall nodes and receive the terms of Step 3.

核对：本页 24 个中心里，16 个的最近点在边内，8 个在顶点上；对每个 di，第三至第五步的公式与 geometry() 的磁带反向扫描给出的 ∂di/∂X 最大相对差 6.2×10−16（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: of this page's 24 centres, 16 have their nearest point inside an edge and 8 at a vertex; for every di, the formulas of Steps 3 to 5 and a reverse sweep of a tape of geometry() give ∂di/∂X with a largest relative difference of 6.2×10−16 (computed by this page's code at build time).

第 2 节Section 2

方程与面通量

The equations and the face flux

要离散的方程

The equations to discretise

守恒形式的 RANS–SA 方程，带时间项：

RANS–SA in conservation form, with the time term:

∂U∂t+∇⋅(𝐅c(U)−𝐅v(U,∇U))=S(U,∇U,d),U=(ρρuρvρEρν~)

本页要的是定常解：∂U/∂t = 0，于是 ∇·(Fc − Fv) = S。时间项仍然要写出来，因为定常解正是靠伪时间推进得到的：从初始状态出发沿 t 推进，直到时间导数消失（第 5 节）。这里的 t 是伪时间，每个控制体取自己的步长，所以推进的中间状态不是真实的时间历程，只有推进到底得到的定常解才有物理意义。

This page wants the steady solution: ∂U/∂t = 0, so that ∇·(Fc − Fv) = S. The time term is still written, because the steady solution is reached by pseudo-time marching: from an initial state, U is advanced in t until the time derivative vanishes (Section 5). Here t is a pseudo time and every control volume takes its own step, so the intermediate states are not a physical time history; only the steady solution the marching ends at has a physical meaning.

对流通量是 Euler 通量加上随质量通量走的 ρν̃；粘性通量是应力、热流与 SA 的扩散：

The convective flux is the Euler flux plus ρν̃ carried by the mass flux; the viscous flux holds the stress, the heat flux and the SA diffusion:

𝐅c ⁣⋅n=(ρqρuq+p nxρvq+p nyρHqρν~q),𝐅v ⁣⋅n=(0(τn)x(τn)yu⋅τn+ke∇T⋅nρa ∇ν~⋅n),q=u⋅n

其中 p=ρT（取 R=1、cv=2.5、cp=3.5，所以 γ=1.4），μ(T)=μref 1.4 T1.5/(T+0.4)（Sutherland），湍流粘度 μt=ρν~fv1(χ)，χ=ρν~/μ，

with p=ρT (R=1, cv=2.5, cp=3.5, so γ=1.4), μ(T)=μref 1.4 T1.5/(T+0.4) (Sutherland), the eddy viscosity μt=ρν~fv1(χ) with χ=ρν~/μ, and

τ=(μ+μt)(∇u+∇uT−23(∇⋅u)I),ke=cp(μPr+μtPrt),ρa=μ+ρν~σ

Pr=0.72、Prt=0.9、σ=2/3。源项只在第 5 个方程里，是 NASA TMR 给出的 SA 守恒形式（密度梯度项不能丢）：

Pr=0.72, Prt=0.9, σ=2/3. The source sits in the fifth equation only; it is the conservative form of the SA model given by NASA's TMR (the density-gradient term must not be dropped):

S5=−a ∇ρ⋅∇ν~+ρ cb2σ∣∇ν~∣2+ρ[cb1(1−ft2)S~ν~−(cw1fw−cb1κ2ft2)(ν~d)2]

模型函数取标准（非负）版本：

The model functions are the standard (not the negative) version:

fv1=χ3χ3+cv13,fv2=1−χ1+χfv1,ft2=ct3e−ct4χ2,B=ν~fv2κ2d2
S~={Ω+B,B≥−c2ΩΩ+Ω (c22Ω+c3B)(c3−2c2)Ω−B,B<−c2Ωr=min⁡ ⁣(ν~κ2d2S~, 10),g=r+cw2(r6−r),fw=g(1+cw36g6+cw36)1/6

Ω = |∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y| 是涡量的大小；常数 cb1 = 0.1355、cb2 = 0.622、κ = 0.41、cw2 = 0.3、cw3 = 2、cv1 = 7.1、ct3 = 1.2、ct4 = 0.5、c2 = 0.7、c3 = 0.9，cw1 = cb1/κ² + (1 + cb2)/σ。

Ω = |∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y| is the size of the vorticity; the constants are cb1 = 0.1355, cb2 = 0.622, κ = 0.41, cw2 = 0.3, cw3 = 2, cv1 = 7.1, ct3 = 1.2, ct4 = 0.5, c2 = 0.7, c3 = 0.9, and cw1 = cb1/κ² + (1 + cb2)/σ.

模型、常数与守恒形式取自 Spalart 与 Allmaras（1994）、Allmaras、Johnson 与 Spalart（2012）以及 NASA 的湍流模型资源网站 TMR；下面的 Roe 通量见 Roe（1981），粘性通量的修正平均梯度与格点页的边式格式见 SU2（Economon 等，2016）。书目列在附录 A 末尾。

The model, its constants and the conservative form follow Spalart and Allmaras (1994), Allmaras, Johnson and Spalart (2012) and NASA's Turbulence Modeling Resource (TMR); the Roe flux below is Roe's (1981), and the corrected average gradient of the viscous flux and the node page's edge-based scheme are SU2's (Economon et al., 2016). The references are listed at the end of Appendix A.

这些函数各有来由。ν̃ 是 SA 的工作变量：离开壁面它就是涡粘性 νt = μt/ρ（fv1 → 1）；靠近壁面 fv1 把它压低，νt = ν̃fv1(χ)，于是 ν̃ 一直到壁面都随 d 线性变化，比 νt 容易算准。方程右端是生成减耗散：湍流由剪切产生，所以生成项与涡量 S̃ 成正比；壁面限制涡的尺度，所以耗散项按 (ν̃/d)² 增长。S̃ = Ω + ν̃fv2/(κ²d²) 在对数层里等于 uτ/(κd)，fv2 让这一关系一直保持到壁面。r = ν̃/(S̃κ²d²) 比较湍流的长度尺度与壁面距离：对数层里 r = 1、fw = 1；离壁面越远 r 越大，fw 趋于常数 (1 + cw36)1/6 ≈ 2.0，所以把 r 截断在 10 并不改变模型，只免得 r6 溢出。ft2 的两项让 ν̃ = 0 成为一个稳定的解，层流区因此不会自己转捩。χ 略大于 1 时 fv2 变负，B 随之为负，Ω + B 可能小于零；2012 年的修正在 B < −c2Ω 时换成第二个式子，它与第一支在 B = −c2Ω 处值与一阶导数都相接，并让 S̃ 始终大于 0.1Ω。

Each of these functions has a purpose. ν̃ is SA's working variable: away from walls it is the eddy viscosity νt = μt/ρ (fv1 → 1); near a wall fv1 damps it, νt = ν̃fv1(χ), so that ν̃ varies linearly with d all the way to the wall and is easier to compute accurately than νt. The right-hand side is production minus destruction: turbulence is produced by shear, so production is proportional to the vorticity S̃; the wall limits the size of the eddies, so destruction grows as (ν̃/d)². S̃ = Ω + ν̃fv2/(κ²d²) equals uτ/(κd) in the log layer, and fv2 keeps that relation all the way to the wall. r = ν̃/(S̃κ²d²) compares the turbulent length scale with the wall distance: r = 1 and fw = 1 in the log layer; further from the wall r grows and fw tends to the constant (1 + cw36)1/6 ≈ 2.0, so capping r at 10 does not change the model and only keeps r6 from overflowing. The two ft2 terms make ν̃ = 0 a stable solution, so a laminar region does not turn turbulent by itself. For χ slightly above 1, fv2 turns negative, B with it, and Ω + B can drop below zero; the 2012 modification switches to the second expression for B < −c2Ω, which meets the first branch at B = −c2Ω in value and first derivative and keeps S̃ above 0.1Ω.

本页的流动：M = 0.2，迎角 5°，μref = 0.02（以物体弦长 1.1 计 Re ≈ 13），来流 ν̃∞ = 3ν∞。出口是牵引力出口，定常尾迹必须顺着出口流出、不能倒流：第 4 级网格上出口的 u·n 最小为 0.07U∞，处处向外。整个区域绝热（壁面、来流、出口都没有热流），粘性加热只能随出口的流动带走，所以温度整体高于来流的 T∞ = 1：第 4 级网格上 T 在 [1.049, 1.099] 之间（来流面上 T 不给定，热也会向上游传到那里）。这样的网格分辨不了真实的高雷诺数边界层；这里要的是一个每个模型分支都用得到、又能收敛到舍入误差的离散问题：S̃ 的修正分支与 r 的截断（第 3 节列出本页网格上用到它们的控制体数），以及涡粘性：来流状态 χ = 3，μt/μ = 0.21；本页（第 0 级网格）各控制体上 μt/μ 最大 0.091（χ 最大 2.41）：χ = ν̃/ν，ν = μ/ρ；区域里 ν̃ 不超过来流值，而 ν 处处至少是来流的 1.04 倍，所以 χ 比来流小。

The flow on this page: M = 0.2, 5° angle of attack, μref = 0.02 (Re ≈ 13 on the body's chord of 1.1), and ν̃∞ = 3ν∞ at the inflow. The outlet is a traction outlet, and the steady wake must leave through it without flowing back: on level 4 the outlet's smallest u·n is 0.07U∞, outward everywhere. The whole domain is adiabatic (no heat flux through the wall, the inflow or the outlet), so the viscous heating can only leave with the outflow, and the temperature lies above the free stream's T∞ = 1 throughout: on level 4, T is between 1.049 and 1.099 (T is not prescribed on the inflow faces, and heat reaches them upstream too). A mesh like this cannot resolve a real high-Reynolds boundary layer; the aim is a discrete problem that exercises every branch of the model and still converges to round-off: the modified branch of S̃ and the cap on r (Section 3 counts the control volumes of this page's mesh that use them), and the eddy viscosity: at the inflow state χ = 3 and μt/μ = 0.21; over the control volumes of this page (the level-0 mesh) μt/μ is at most 0.091 (χ at most 2.41): χ = ν̃/ν with ν = μ/ρ, and inside the domain ν̃ does not exceed its inflow value while ν is everywhere at least 1.04 times the inflow's, so χ stays below the inflow's.

有限体积形式

The finite-volume form

对每个控制体积分（Ui 取控制体上的平均值），散度变成面上的通量和，每个控制体得到一个关于 t 的常微分方程（半离散形式）：

Integrated over each control volume (Ui is the average over it), the divergence becomes a sum of face fluxes, and each control volume gets an ordinary differential equation in t (the semi-discrete form):

Vi dUidt+Ri(U)=0,Ri(U)=∑f∈∂Ωi± Φf−ViSi
Φf=roe(WL+,WR+,nf)⏟convective−visc(W,G,f)⏟viscous

面通量 Φf 从 L 流向 R：对 L 加、对 R 减，保证守恒。W = (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃) 是原始变量，G 是它们的最小二乘梯度，W+ 是重构到面上的状态。

The face flux Φf runs from L to R: added to L and subtracted from R, which makes the scheme conservative. W = (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃) are the primitive variables, G their least-squares gradients, and W+ the state reconstructed to the face.

定常解满足 R(U) = 0：这就是本页要解、并在之后各节求导的离散方程；时间项只在求解时出现（第 5 节）。

The steady solution satisfies R(U) = 0: that is the discrete equation this page solves and, in the later sections, differentiates; the time term appears in the solve only (Section 5).

每个面仍是一个一维问题：Roe 通量

Every face is still a one-dimensional problem: the Roe flux

面的两侧各有一个状态，Roe 通量把它们的差分解成五道波：两道声波（速度 q̃ ∓ c̃）、熵波、剪切波与 ν̃ 波（速度都是 q̃），每道波按它速度的绝对值加耗散：

Each side of a face carries a state, and the Roe flux splits their difference into five waves: two acoustic waves (speeds q̃ ∓ c̃), and the entropy, shear and ν̃ waves (all at speed q̃); each wave is dissipated in proportion to the size of its speed:

roe(WL,WR,n)=∣n∣[12(F(WL)+F(WR))⋅n^−12∑k=15∣Λk∣ Δk rk]

~ 表示 Roe 平均（以 √ρ 加权：ρ̃ = √(ρLρR)，ũ、H̃、ν̃~ 是两侧的加权平均），c̃² = (γ − 1)(H̃ − ½|ũ|²)，q̃ = ũ·n̂。Δ 表示 R 侧减 L 侧的跳跃，Δq = Δu·n̂。Λk 是第 k 道波的波速，rk 是 Roe 平均状态处通量 Jacobian 的右特征向量（分量按 ρ、ρu、ρv、ρE、ρν̃ 排列），Δk 是波强：把跳跃 ΔU 写成 ΣkΔkrk 时的系数。

The ~ marks a Roe average (weighted by √ρ: ρ̃ = √(ρLρR), and ũ, H̃, ν̃~ are the weighted averages of the two sides), c̃² = (γ − 1)(H̃ − ½|ũ|²) and q̃ = ũ·n̂. Δ is a jump, the R side minus the L side, and Δq = Δu·n̂. Λk is the speed of wave k, rk the right eigenvector of the flux Jacobian at the Roe-averaged state (components ordered ρ, ρu, ρv, ρE, ρν̃), and Δk the wave strength: the coefficient of rk when the jump ΔU is written as ΣkΔkrk.

Λ1,3=q~∓c~,Δ1,3=Δp∓ρ~c~ Δq2c~2,r1,3=(1, u~∓c~n^x, v~∓c~n^y, H~∓q~c~, ν~~)TΛ2=q~,Δ2=Δρ−Δpc~2,r2=(1, u~, v~, 12(u~2+v~2), ν~~)TΛ4,5=q~,Δ4r4=ρ~ (0, Δu−Δq n^x, Δv−Δq n^y, u~Δu+v~Δv−q~Δq, 0)T,Δ5r5=ρ~ Δν~ (0,0,0,0,1)T

两道声波（k = 1、3）、熵波（k = 2）、剪切波（k = 4）与 ν̃ 波（k = 5）；后三道都以 q̃ 移动。剪切波与 ν̃ 波直接写成乘积 Δkrk。ρν̃ 作为被动标量跟着质量通量走：r1,2,3 的最后一个分量是 ν̃~，所以它的耗散是 ν̃~ 乘质量方程的耗散，再加 ν̃ 波的 |q̃|ρ̃Δν̃。残差里的特征值不做熵修正：熵修正是为了在声速点（|q̃ ± c̃| → 0）附近防止出现非物理的膨胀激波，本页 M = 0.2，处处亚声速，用不到它。代价是 |Λk| 在 q̃ = 0 处不可导（第 3 节列出它离当前解多远）。

The two acoustic waves (k = 1, 3), the entropy wave (k = 2), the shear wave (k = 4) and the ν̃ wave (k = 5); the last three all move at q̃. The shear and ν̃ waves are written directly as the products Δkrk. ρν̃ rides on the mass flux as a passive scalar: the last component of r1,2,3 is ν̃~, so its dissipation is ν̃~ times the mass equation's, plus the ν̃ wave's |q̃|ρ̃Δν̃. The residual's eigenvalues carry no entropy fix: an entropy fix keeps non-physical expansion shocks from forming near sonic points (|q̃ ± c̃| → 0), and this page's flow at M = 0.2 is subsonic everywhere. The price is that |Λk| is not differentiable at q̃ = 0 (Section 3 lists how far the solution is from it).

图 2.1Figure 2.1

逐步推导：Roe 平均、波分解与 Roe 通量的线性化

Step by step: Roe averages, the wave decomposition and the linearisation of the Roe flux

第一步，Roe 平均的乘积法则。任一量 φ 的 Roe 平均是 φ̃ = (√ρLφL + √ρRφR)/(√ρL + √ρR)，ρ̃ = √(ρLρR)。直接展开（用 ρR − ρL = (√ρR − √ρL)(√ρR + √ρL)）：

Step 1, the product rule of Roe averages. The Roe average of any quantity φ is φ̃ = (√ρLφL + √ρRφR)/(√ρL + √ρR), and ρ̃ = √(ρLρR). Expanding directly (with ρR − ρL = (√ρR − √ρL)(√ρR + √ρL)):

φ~ Δρ+ρ~ Δφ=(ρLφL+ρRφR)(ρR−ρL)+ρLρR (φR−φL)=ρRφR−ρLφL=Δ(ρφ)

所以对 φ = u、v、H、ν̃，守恒量的跳跃 Δ(ρφ) 精确地等于 φ̃Δρ + ρ̃Δφ：在 Roe 平均处把跳跃线性化没有误差。

So for φ = u, v, H, ν̃ the jump of the conserved quantity Δ(ρφ) is exactly φ̃Δρ + ρ̃Δφ: linearising the jump at the Roe average makes no error.

第二步，压力的跳跃。本页 p = ρT、ρE = ρ(cvT + ½|u|²)，所以 p = (γ − 1)(ρE − ½ρ|u|²)。写 ρ|u|² = |√ρ u|²，并用 √ρLuL + √ρRuR = (√ρL + √ρR)ũ，得 ½Δ(ρ|u|²) = ũ·Δ(ρu) − ½|ũ|²Δρ，于是

Step 2, the pressure jump. On this page p = ρT and ρE = ρ(cvT + ½|u|²), so p = (γ − 1)(ρE − ½ρ|u|²). Writing ρ|u|² = |√ρ u|² and using √ρLuL + √ρRuR = (√ρL + √ρR)ũ gives ½Δ(ρ|u|²) = ũ·Δ(ρu) − ½|ũ|²Δρ, hence

Δp=(γ−1)[Δ(ρE)−u~ Δ(ρu)−v~ Δ(ρv)+12(u~2+v~2)Δρ]c~2=(γ−1)(H~−12(u~2+v~2))

第三步，求波强。把跳跃写成 ΔU = ΣkΔkrk，逐个分量比较（rk 见上式）。质量分量：Δ1 + Δ2 + Δ3 = Δρ。法向动量 n̂·Δ(ρu) = q̃Δρ + ρ̃Δq：c̃(Δ3 − Δ1) = ρ̃Δq。把第二步方括号里的组合作用在每个 rk 上，r1、r3 给 c̃²，r2 与剪切、ν̃ 两个向量给 0，所以 c̃²(Δ1 + Δ3) = Δp。三式联立：

Step 3, the wave strengths. Write the jump as ΔU = ΣkΔkrk and compare component by component (the rk as above). The mass component: Δ1 + Δ2 + Δ3 = Δρ. The normal momentum n̂·Δ(ρu) = q̃Δρ + ρ̃Δq: c̃(Δ3 − Δ1) = ρ̃Δq. Step 2's bracket applied to each rk gives c̃² for r1 and r3 and 0 for r2 and the shear and ν̃ vectors, so c̃²(Δ1 + Δ3) = Δp. Together:

Δ1,3=Δp∓ρ~c~ Δq2c~2,Δ2=Δρ−Δpc~2

动量里剩下的 ρ̃(Δu − Δq n̂) 是剪切波；ρν̃ 里剩下的 ρ̃Δν̃（第一步取 φ = ν̃）是 ν̃ 波：正是上面的 Δ4r4、Δ5r5。

What remains in the momentum, ρ̃(Δu − Δq n̂), is the shear wave; what remains in ρν̃, ρ̃Δν̃ (Step 1 with φ = ν̃), is the ν̃ wave: the Δ4r4 and Δ5r5 above.

第四步，耗散矩阵。rk 是 Roe 平均状态处通量 Jacobian 的特征向量，特征值 Λk。把跳跃按特征向量展开、逐波乘 |Λk|，就是 |J̃c|ΔU。记 𝓡 = (r1, …, r5)：

Step 4, the dissipation matrix. The rk are the eigenvectors of the flux Jacobian at the Roe-averaged state, with eigenvalues Λk. Expanding the jump in eigenvectors and multiplying each wave by |Λk| gives |J̃c|ΔU. With 𝓡 = (r1, …, r5):

∑k∣Λk∣ Δk rk=ℛ ∣Λ∣ ℛ−1 ΔU=∣J~c∣ ΔU,(∣J~c∣ΔU)ρν~=ν~~ (∣J~c∣ΔU)ρ+∣q~∣ ρ~ Δν~

第二式来自 r1、r2、r3 的最后一个分量都是 ν̃~、剪切波的是 0（model.js 的 d4 = st·d0 + sh·ds）。所以 |J̃c| 的 ρν̃ 列只有对角元 |q̃|：ν̃ 不进入平均流方程的耗散，而 ρν̃ 的耗散是质量耗散乘 ν̃~ 再加自己的一项。本页一个面上的 |J̃c| 见图 2.2。

The second formula holds because the last component of r1, r2 and r3 is ν̃~ and that of the shear wave is 0 (model.js's d4 = st·d0 + sh·ds). So the ρν̃ column of |J̃c| holds only the diagonal |q̃|: ν̃ does not enter the mean-flow equations' dissipation, and ρν̃'s dissipation is the mass dissipation times ν̃~ plus a term of its own. Figure 2.2 shows |J̃c| on one face of this page.

第五步，线性化。一阶格式 Φ = |n|[½(F(UL) + F(UR))·n̂ − ½|J̃c|ΔU]，而 J̃c 同时依赖两侧状态，所以

Step 5, the linearisation. At first order Φ = |n|[½(F(UL) + F(UR))·n̂ − ½|J̃c|ΔU], and J̃c depends on both states, so

∂Φ∂UL=∣n∣[12Jc(UL)+12∣J~c∣−12 ∂∣J~c∣∂UL ΔU]

最后一项与跳跃 ΔU 成正比，含 |Λk| 的导数 sgn Λk（Λk = 0 处不可导，第 3 节列出了余量）。局部磁带对核的每个运算求导，三项全部精确算到；第 5 节的近似 Jacobian 只留前两项。二阶格式的面状态是 WL+ = WL + GL·(xf − xL)，所以核对 WL 的导数等于对 WL+ 的导数，对 GL 的导数是它再乘 (xf − xL)T：面核的 30 个输入就是这样来的。

The last term is proportional to the jump ΔU and contains the derivative of |Λk|, sgn Λk (not differentiable at Λk = 0; Section 3 lists the margins). The local tape differentiates every operation of the kernel, so all three terms come out exactly; the approximate Jacobian of Section 5 keeps only the first two. At second order the face state is WL+ = WL + GL·(xf − xL), so the kernel's derivative with respect to WL equals that with respect to WL+, and with respect to GL it is that times (xf − xL)T: that is where the face kernel's 30 inputs come from.

核对：本页全部 32 个内部面上（U* 处的二阶面状态），Jc(W̃)rk = Λkrk 的相对残差最大 2.6×10−16；ΣkΔkrk 重建跳跃 ΔU 到 1.3×10−13；𝓡|Λ|𝓡−1ΔU 与 model.js 的耗散相差 5.4×10−14；Roe 性质 F(UR) − F(UL) = Jc(W̃)ΔU 成立到 1.1×10−13；|J̃c| 的 ρν̃ 行与列符合第四步到 4.2×10−18。第五步被丢掉的最后一项（一阶、中心状态）占磁带给出的 ∂Φ/∂UL 的比例（Frobenius 范数）：最大 5.4%，中位数 1.3%（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: on all 32 interior faces of this page (the second-order face states at U*), Jc(W̃)rk = Λkrk holds to a relative residual of at most 2.6×10−16; ΣkΔkrk rebuilds the jump ΔU to 1.3×10−13; 𝓡|Λ|𝓡−1ΔU agrees with model.js's dissipation to 5.4×10−14; Roe's property F(UR) − F(UL) = Jc(W̃)ΔU holds to 1.1×10−13; and the ρν̃ row and column of |J̃c| follow Step 4 to 4.2×10−18. The last term dropped in Step 5 (first order, centre states) is at most 5.4% of the taped ∂Φ/∂UL (Frobenius norm), 1.3% at the median (computed by this page's code at build time).

第二步的恒等式与第三步的分解另由 sympy 符号验证（check_enrich_sympy.py）。

The identity of Step 2 and the decomposition of Step 3 are also verified symbolically by sympy (check_enrich_sympy.py).

最小二乘重构：一阶与二阶

Least-squares reconstruction: first and second order

每个控制体的梯度来自无权最小二乘：

Each control volume's gradient comes from unweighted least squares:

Gi=(∑jΔxij ΔxijT)−1∑jΔxij (Wj−Wi),Δxij=xj−xi

模板是面相邻的单元。贴壁单元还有一个“壁面点”（壁面面的中点），那里 u = v = ν̃ = 0 已知；ρ 与 T 在绝热壁上不知道，所以贴壁单元用两组权重：u、v、ν̃ 用含壁面点的一组，ρ、T 用只含邻居的一组。两组都对线性场精确。远场面不进入模板。二阶格式把中心值沿 xf − xi 外推：W+ = Wi + Gi·(xf − xi)，不加限制器（流动无激波）；一阶格式直接取 W+ = Wi。粘性通量与 SA 源项在两种格式里都用这些梯度，所以一阶／二阶开关只改变对流通量。

The stencil is the face neighbours. A wall cell also has a “wall point” (its wall face's midpoint), where u = v = ν̃ = 0 are known; ρ and T are not known on an adiabatic wall, so a wall cell has two weight sets: u, v and ν̃ use the one with the wall point, ρ and T the one with the neighbours only. Both are exact for linear fields. Far-field faces take no part in any stencil. The second-order scheme extrapolates the centre value along xf − xi: W+ = Wi + Gi·(xf − xi), without a limiter (the flow has no shocks); the first-order scheme takes W+ = Wi. The viscous flux and the SA source use these gradients in both schemes, so the first/second-order switch changes the convective flux only.

逐步推导：最小二乘梯度、它的权重与转置

Step by step: the least-squares gradient, its weights and its transpose

第一步，拟合问题。在中心 xi 附近用线性函数 Wi + G·(x − xi) 拟合模板点上的值，取使误差平方和最小的 G（W 的每个分量分别做）：

Step 1, the fitting problem. Near the centre xi, fit the values at the stencil points by the linear function Wi + G·(x − xi), and take the G that minimises the sum of squared misfits (for each component of W separately):

Gi=arg min⁡G ∑j(Wi+G⋅Δxij−Wj)2,Δxij=xj−xi

第二步，法方程。对 G 求梯度并令其为零：

Step 2, the normal equations. Set the gradient with respect to G to zero:

∑j2 Δxij(G⋅Δxij−(Wj−Wi))=0⟹𝒩i Gi=∑jΔxij (Wj−Wi),𝒩i=∑jΔxijΔxijT

𝒩i 是 2×2 对称矩阵；只要模板点不全在一条过 xi 的直线上，它就正定。

𝒩i is a symmetric 2×2 matrix, positive definite as long as the stencil points do not all lie on one line through xi.

第三步，显式的权重。2×2 矩阵的逆直接写出（mesh.js 的 weights 正是这几行）：

Step 3, explicit weights. The inverse of a 2×2 matrix written out (mesh.js's weights are exactly these lines):

𝒩i−1=1𝒩xx𝒩yy−𝒩xy2(𝒩yy−𝒩xy−𝒩xy𝒩xx),Γij=𝒩i−1Δxij,Gi=∑jΓij (Wj−Wi)

权重 Γij 只依赖几何，与 W 无关：梯度那一遍是线性算子 Γ，Γij 就是它的元素。

The weights Γij depend on the geometry only, not on W: the gradient pass is the linear operator Γ, and the Γij are its entries.

第四步，线性场精确。若 W 是线性场，Wj − Wi = Δxij·∇W 对所有 j 成立，则

Step 4, exact for linear fields. If W is linear, Wj − Wi = Δxij·∇W for every j, and then

Gi=𝒩i−1∑jΔxij ΔxijT ∇W=∇W,that is∑jΓij ΔxijT=I

贴壁单元的两组权重各自满足这个恒等式：u、v、ν̃ 用的一组含壁面点（那里 Wj = 0 已知），ρ、T 用的一组只含邻居。

A wall cell's two weight sets satisfy it each: the one for u, v, ν̃ includes the wall point (where Wj = 0 is known), the one for ρ and T only the neighbours.

第五步，前向与转置。Γ 是线性的，前向就是同一组权重作用在 W˙ 上；伴随把它转置，梯度 Gi 的伴随 Gˉi 按累加送回整个模板：

Step 5, the tangent and the transpose. Γ is linear, so the tangent applies the same weights to W˙; the adjoint transposes it, and the adjoint Gˉi of the gradient Gi goes back over the whole stencil as accumulations:

G˙i=∑jΓij (W˙j−W˙i)⟺Wˉj+=Γij⋅Gˉi,Wˉi–=Γij⋅Gˉi

两者是同一个双线性型 ∑iGˉi⋅∑jΓij(W˙j−W˙i) 按两种次序求和（core.js applyAT 的 “pass 1 reversed”）；两个方向画在图 2.3 (b) 里。

Both are the same bilinear form ∑iGˉi⋅∑jΓij(W˙j−W˙i), summed in two orders (core.js applyAT's “pass 1 reversed”); both directions are drawn in Figure 2.3 (b).

第六步，对坐标的前向导数（第 11 节用）。Δxij 随中心移动，Δx˙ij=x˙j−x˙i；由 (𝒩−1)⋅=−𝒩−1𝒩˙𝒩−1，

Step 6, the forward derivative with respect to the coordinates (used in Section 11). Δxij moves with the centres, Δx˙ij=x˙j−x˙i; with (𝒩−1)⋅=−𝒩−1𝒩˙𝒩−1,

Γ˙ij=𝒩i−1(Δx˙ij−𝒩˙i Γij),𝒩˙i=∑k(Δx˙ik ΔxikT+Δxik Δx˙ikT)

核对：本页 32 组权重（邻居个数：8 个控制体有 2 个、16 个控制体有 3 个，贴壁单元另有壁面点）：第三步的 Γij 与 mesh.js 算出的权重最大相对差 0；ΣjΓijΔxijT 与 I 相差 5.6×10−16；一个线性场的梯度误差 6.7×10−16；沿一个随机坐标方向，第六步的 Γ˙ij 与几何磁带的前向扫描相差 3.5×10−15；随机向量上 ⟨Gˉ,ΓW˙⟩ 与 ⟨ΓTGˉ,W˙⟩ 相差 2.2×10−16（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: this page's 32 weight sets (neighbours: 8 control volumes have 2, 16 control volumes have 3, and the wall cells also have the wall point): the Γij of Step 3 and mesh.js's weights differ by at most 0; ΣjΓijΔxijT differs from I by 5.6×10−16; a linear field's gradient is off by 6.7×10−16; along a random coordinate direction, Step 6's Γ˙ij and a forward sweep of the geometry's tape differ by 3.5×10−15; and on random vectors ⟨Gˉ,ΓW˙⟩ and ⟨ΓTGˉ,W˙⟩ differ by 2.2×10−16 (computed by this page's code at build time).

粘性通量：边上的修正平均梯度

The viscous flux: the corrected average gradient on the edge

逐步推导：修正平均梯度与粘性通量的线性化

Step by step: the corrected average gradient and the linearisation of the viscous flux

第一步，拆开平均梯度。对 u、v、T、ν̃ 中的某个分量 φ，记两侧最小二乘梯度的平均为 ∇φavg = ½(GL + GR)，Δx = xR − xL，单位向量 Δx̂ = Δx/|Δx|。把平均梯度拆成沿 Δx 与垂直于 Δx 的两部分：

Step 1, split the average gradient. For one component φ of u, v, T, ν̃, let ∇φavg = ½(GL + GR) be the mean of the two least-squares gradients, Δx = xR − xL, and Δx̂ = Δx/|Δx| its unit vector. Split the mean into its parts along and across Δx:

∇φavg=(∇φavg⋅Δx^) Δx^+(I−Δx^ Δx^T)∇φavg

第二步，替换沿 Δx 的部分。沿 Δx 的方向导数改用两个中心值的差 (φR − φL)/|Δx|，得到面上的梯度 ∇fφ（model.js 的 corrected()）：

Step 2, replace the part along Δx. The directional derivative along Δx is replaced by the difference of the two centre values, (φR − φL)/|Δx|, which gives the face gradient ∇fφ (model.js corrected()):

∇ ⁣fφ=(I−Δx^ Δx^T)∇φavg+φR−φL∣Δx∣ Δx^=∇φavg−(∇φavg⋅Δx−(φR−φL))Δx∣Δx∣2

第三步，面梯度的导数。∇fφ 对它的四个输入都是线性的：

Step 3, the derivatives of the face gradient. ∇fφ is linear in each of its four inputs:

∂∇ ⁣fφ∂φR=−∂∇ ⁣fφ∂φL=Δx∣Δx∣2,∂∇ ⁣fφ∂GL=∂∇ ⁣fφ∂GR=12(I−Δx^ Δx^T)

两侧的梯度只经过“垂直于 Δx 的投影”进入；沿 Δx 只剩两点差，所以不会出现棋盘模式。

The two gradients enter only through the projection across Δx; along Δx only the two-point difference remains, so no checkerboard mode appears.

第四步，通量与系数。面上的粘性通量（第 2 节的 Fv·n）读四个面梯度与两侧平均的系数：

Step 4, the flux and its coefficients. The face's viscous flux (Section 2's Fv·n) reads the four face gradients and coefficients averaged over the two sides:

τn=μe[(∇ ⁣f𝐮+∇ ⁣f𝐮T)n−23tr⁡(∇ ⁣f𝐮) n]Fv ⁣⋅n=(0, τn, 𝐮avg⋅τn+ke ∇ ⁣fT⋅n, ρa ∇ ⁣fν~⋅n)
μe=12(μL+μR)+12(μt,L+μt,R),𝐮avg=12(𝐮L+𝐮R)ke=cp(μavgPr+μtavgPrt),ρa=μavg+12(ρLν~L+ρRν~R)σ

这里 ∇fu 是以 ∇fu、∇fv 为行的 2×2 矩阵，uavg、μavg、μtavg 是两侧的平均（与第一步的 ∇φavg 同一个写法）。

Here ∇fu is the 2×2 matrix with rows ∇fu and ∇fv, and uavg, μavg, μtavg are the averages of the two sides (written like Step 1's ∇φavg).

第五步，系数的导数。Sutherland 律 μ = μref·1.4T1.5/(T + 0.4) 给 μT = dμ/dT = μ(1.5/T − 1/(T + 0.4))；μt = ρν̃fv1(χ)，χ = ρν̃/μ，fv1′ = 3cv1³χ²/(χ³ + cv1³)²，于是（其余原始变量固定）

Step 5, the derivatives of the coefficients. Sutherland's law μ = μref·1.4T1.5/(T + 0.4) gives μT = dμ/dT = μ(1.5/T − 1/(T + 0.4)); μt = ρν̃fv1(χ) with χ = ρν̃/μ and fv1′ = 3cv1³χ²/(χ³ + cv1³)², so (the other primitives held)

∂μt∂ρ=ν~ (fv1+χfv1′),∂μt∂ν~=ρ (fv1+χfv1′),∂μt∂T=−ρν~ χfv1′ μTμ

第六步，链式法则（前向模式）。τn 对 μe 与四个面梯度都是线性的；面梯度 ∇f 对它的四个输入也是线性的，作用在带点的输入上就是它的前向导数（第三步），法向 n 固定。所以

Step 6, the chain rule (forward mode). τn is linear in μe and in the four face gradients; the face gradient ∇f is linear in its four inputs as well, so applied to the dotted inputs it is its own forward derivative (Step 3), with the normal n held. So

τ˙ n=μ˙eμe τn+μe[(∇ ⁣f𝐮˙+∇ ⁣f𝐮˙T)n−23tr⁡(∇ ⁣f𝐮˙)n]μ˙e=12∑L,R(μT T˙+∂μt∂ρρ˙+∂μt∂TT˙+∂μt∂ν~ν~˙)

能量与 ν̃ 两行同理，按乘积法则逐项加点：

The energy and ν̃ rows follow the same way, a dot on each factor in turn by the product rule:

(𝐮avg ⁣⋅τn+ke∇ ⁣fT⋅n)⋅=𝐮˙avg ⁣⋅τn+𝐮avg ⁣⋅τ˙ n+k˙e∇ ⁣fT⋅n+ke∇ ⁣fT˙⋅n,(ρa ∇ ⁣fν~⋅n)⋅=(ρa)⋅ ∇ ⁣fν~⋅n+ρa ∇ ⁣fν~˙⋅n

局部磁带记下的正是这些乘积：面核对 WL、WR 的导数含系数与两点差两部分，对 GL、GR 的导数只含第三步的投影。

These products are exactly what the local tape records: the face kernel's derivative with respect to WL, WR has a coefficient part and a two-point part, and with respect to GL, GR only Step 3's projection.

核对：本页每个内部面上，corrected() 的磁带导数与第三步的公式相差 2.0×10−16；每个控制体上，viscosity() 与 eddy() 的磁带给出的 μT 与第五步三个偏导数与公式相差 9.0×10−16（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: on every interior face of this page, the taped derivatives of corrected() and Step 3's formulas differ by 2.0×10−16; in every control volume, μT and the three partials of Step 5 from the tapes of viscosity() and eddy() differ from the formulas by 9.0×10−16 (computed by this page's code at build time).

SA 源项

The SA source

源项是每个控制体一个点的积分：Vi 乘以中心处的 S5。它读三样东西：中心的 W、最小二乘梯度 G（涡量、∇ν̃、∇ρ）、壁面距离 d。

The source is a one-point integral per control volume: Vi times S5 at the centre. It reads three things: the centre's W, the least-squares gradients G (the vorticity, ∇ν̃, ∇ρ), and the wall distance d.

逐步推导：SA 源项对 W、G 与 d 的导数

Step by step: the derivatives of the SA source with respect to W, G and d

源项核的局部 Jacobian Js（15 个输入、1 个输出；第 11 节还要它对壁面距离 d 的导数）由局部磁带求出。这里把磁带做的事按前向模式一层一层写出来：每一层给出它的点。控制体 i 的源项进入残差的 ρν̃ 行：

The source kernel's local Jacobian Js (15 inputs and 1 output; Section 11 also needs its derivative with respect to the wall distance d) comes from the local tape. Here is what the tape does in forward mode, layer by layer: each layer gives its dot. The source of control volume i enters the residual's ρν̃ row:

Ri,ρν~←Ri,ρν~+Vi si,s=a ∇ρ⋅∇ν~−ρ b ∣∇ν~∣2−ρ Q,a=ν+ν~σ,b=cb2σ
Q=cb1(1−ft2) S~ ν~−(cw1fw−cb1κ2ft2)(ν~d)2

Q 是第 2 节 S5 方括号里的净源项，s = −S5。输入是中心值 Wi = (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃)、梯度 Gi（10 个分量）与 di。

Q is the net source inside the bracket of Section 2's S5, and s = −S5. The inputs are the centre values Wi = (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃), the gradients Gi (10 entries) and di.

第一步，分子粘性。ν = μ/ρ，μ(T) 是 Sutherland 律：

Step 1, the molecular viscosity. ν = μ/ρ, and μ(T) is Sutherland's law:

μT=dμdT=μ(1.5T−1T+0.4),∂ν∂ρ=−νρ,∂ν∂T=μTρ

第二步，χ = ν̃/ν = ρν̃/μ：

Step 2, χ = ν̃/ν = ρν̃/μ:

∂χ∂ν~=1ν,∂χ∂ρ=χρ,∂χ∂T=−χ μTμ

第三步，三个阻尼函数只依赖 χ（fv2′ 用商的求导法则，1 + χfv1 − χ(fv1 + χfv1′) = 1 − χ²fv1′）：

Step 3, the three damping functions depend on χ only (fv2′ by the quotient rule, with 1 + χfv1 − χ(fv1 + χfv1′) = 1 − χ²fv1′):

fv1′=3cv13χ2(χ3+cv13)2,fv2′=χ2fv1′−1(1+χfv1)2,ft2′=−2ct4 χ ft2

第四步，B = ν̃fv2/(κ²d²)。ν̃ 既直接出现，又经 χ 出现，而 ν̃·∂χ/∂ν̃ = χ；ρ 与 T 只经 χ 进入：

Step 4, B = ν̃fv2/(κ²d²). ν̃ appears directly and through χ, with ν̃·∂χ/∂ν̃ = χ; ρ and T enter through χ only:

∂B∂ν~=fv2+χfv2′κ2d2,∂B∂z=ν~fv2′κ2d2 ∂χ∂z  (z=ρ,T),∂B∂d=−2Bd

第五步，涡量。ω = ∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y 取自最小二乘梯度 Gi，Ω = |ω|：

Step 5, the vorticity. ω = ∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y comes from the least-squares gradients Gi, and Ω = |ω|:

∂Ω∂(∂v/∂x)=sgn⁡ω,∂Ω∂(∂u/∂y)=−sgn⁡ω

第六步，S̃ 的两支。第一支 S̃ = Ω + B：FB = ∂S̃/∂B = 1，FΩ = ∂S̃/∂Ω = 1。第二支 S̃ = Ω + Ω(c2²Ω + c3B)/D0，D0 = (c3 − 2c2)Ω − B，用商的求导法则：

Step 6, the two branches of S̃. First branch, S̃ = Ω + B: FB = ∂S̃/∂B = 1 and FΩ = ∂S̃/∂Ω = 1. Second branch, S̃ = Ω + Ω(c2²Ω + c3B)/D0 with D0 = (c3 − 2c2)Ω − B, by the quotient rule:

FB=(c3−c2)2 Ω2D02,FΩ=1+(2c22Ω+c3B) D0−(c3−2c2) Ω (c22Ω+c3B)D02

在接缝 B = −c2Ω 处 D0 = (c3 − c2)Ω，第二支的分式等于 −c2Ω：两支的值都是 (1 − c2)Ω，FB 与 FΩ 也都等于 1，所以 S̃ 在接缝处一阶连续。于是 S~˙=FBB˙+FΩΩ˙。本页 24 个控制体里，第二支在 8 个上起作用。

At the seam B = −c2Ω, D0 = (c3 − c2)Ω and the second branch's fraction equals −c2Ω: both branches give (1 − c2)Ω, and FB and FΩ both equal 1, so S̃ is continuously differentiable across the seam. Hence S~˙=FBB˙+FΩΩ˙. Of this page's 24 control volumes, the second branch is active in 8.

第七步，r 与截断。r0 = ν̃/(κ²d²S̃)；未截断时

Step 7, r and its cap. r0 = ν̃/(κ²d²S̃); uncapped,

r˙=1κ2d2S~(ν~˙−ν~S~ S~˙−2ν~d d˙)

截断时 r = 10 是常数，r˙=0：那里 fw 对任何输入都没有导数。本页 7 个控制体被截断。

When capped, r = 10 is a constant and r˙=0: there fw has no derivative with respect to any input. On this page 7 control volumes are capped.

第八步，g 与 fw。对 fw = g(1 + cw3⁶)1/6(g⁶ + cw3⁶)−1/6 求导，(g⁶ + cw3⁶)−1/6 − g⁶(g⁶ + cw3⁶)−7/6 = cw3⁶(g⁶ + cw3⁶)−7/6：

Step 8, g and fw. Differentiating fw = g(1 + cw3⁶)1/6(g⁶ + cw3⁶)−1/6, with (g⁶ + cw3⁶)−1/6 − g⁶(g⁶ + cw3⁶)−7/6 = cw3⁶(g⁶ + cw3⁶)−7/6:

dgdr=1−cw2+6cw2 r5,dfwdg=(1+cw36g6+cw36)1/6cw36g6+cw36,f˙w=dfwdg dgdr r˙

第九步，净源项。把以上各层代进 Q（f˙t2=ft2′χ˙）：

Step 9, the net source. Put the layers above into Q (f˙t2=ft2′χ˙):

Q˙=cb1[(1−ft2)(ν~ S~˙+S~ ν~˙)−ν~S~ f˙t2]−(ν~d)2(cw1 f˙w−cb1κ2 f˙t2)−(cw1fw−cb1κ2ft2) 2ν~d(ν~˙d−ν~ d˙d2)

第十步，守恒形式的两项。密度梯度项 a∇ρ·∇ν̃ 与 cb2 项 ρb|∇ν̃|² 的导数直接写出：

Step 10, the two terms of the conservative form. The derivatives of the density-gradient term a∇ρ·∇ν̃ and the cb2 term ρb|∇ν̃|² written directly:

∂(a∇ρ⋅∇ν~)∂∇ρ=a∇ν~,∂(a∇ρ⋅∇ν~)∂∇ν~=a∇ρ,∂(a∇ρ⋅∇ν~)∂(ρ, T, ν~)=∇ρ⋅∇ν~σ(−νρ, μTρ, 1)∂(ρb∣∇ν~∣2)∂ρ=b∣∇ν~∣2,∂(ρb∣∇ν~∣2)∂∇ν~=2ρb ∇ν~

第十一步，装配 Js。s 对每个输入的导数是以上各项之和，其中 −ρQ 对 ρ 的导数是 −Q − ρ∂Q/∂ρ；乘以 Vi 就是 Js 的一行。16 个输入里有 10 个出现：ρ、T、ν̃、∇ρ 的两个分量、∂u/∂y、∂v/∂x、∇ν̃ 的两个分量与 d；u、v、∂u/∂x、∂v/∂y 与 ∇T 的导数恒为零。各部分在本页的大小见图 2.6。

Step 11, assemble Js. The derivative of s with respect to each input is the sum of the terms above, where −ρQ contributes −Q − ρ∂Q/∂ρ to the ρ entry; times Vi it is the row Js. 10 of the 16 inputs appear: ρ, T, ν̃, the two components of ∇ρ, ∂u/∂y, ∂v/∂x, the two components of ∇ν̃, and d; the derivatives with respect to u, v, ∂u/∂x, ∂v/∂y and ∇T are identically zero. Figure 2.6 shows how large each part is on this page.

核对：把上面十一步照写成代码（enrich_data.js 的 saHand，不调用 model.js 的源项），在 U* 的每个求源项的控制体（24 个）上与 model.js source() 的磁带比较：16 个导数的最大相对差 4.3×10−14，源项值 1.4×10−15。其中第二支 8 个、r 截断 7 个、生成项为负（ft2 > 1）9 个（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: the eleven steps written out as code (enrich_data.js saHand, which does not call model.js's source) and the tape of model.js source() compared in every control volume where the source is evaluated (24 of them) at U*: the 16 derivatives differ by at most 4.3×10−14 (relative), the source's value by 1.4×10−15. Among them 8 are on the second branch, 7 capped, and 9 have negative production (ft2 > 1) (computed by this page's code at build time).

第三、六、七、八步的公式与接缝处的一阶连续另由 sympy 符号验证（check_enrich_sympy.py）。

The formulas of Steps 3, 6, 7 and 8 and the continuity at the seam are also verified symbolically by sympy (check_enrich_sympy.py).

第 3 节Section 3

边界条件

Boundary conditions

内圈：弱条件的无滑移绝热壁

Inner ring: the no-slip adiabatic wall, weakly

壁面面的通量里没有质量、能量与 ν̃ 的对流（u = 0）；动量通量是壁面压力 pw = ρwTw（ρw、Tw 是单元自己重构到壁面的值；一阶格式直接取单元值）减去粘性应力；能量通量为零（绝热，且 uw = 0 时应力不做功）；ν̃ 方程有扩散通量 ρa ∇ν̃·n 流向壁面，因为壁面上 ν̃ = 0。

The wall face's flux carries no convection of mass, energy or ν̃ (u = 0); the momentum flux is the wall pressure pw = ρwTw (ρw, Tw are the cell's own reconstruction to the wall; the first-order scheme takes the cell values) minus the viscous stress; the energy flux is zero (adiabatic, and the stress does no work where uw = 0); the ν̃ equation has a diffusive flux ρa ∇ν̃·n into the wall, since ν̃ = 0 there.

外圈：远场

Outer ring: the far field

来流面的对流通量是边界状态 Wbc = (ρ∞, u∞, v∞, Tf, ν̃∞) 的物理通量 F(Wbc)·n，Tf 是面状态自己的温度（T 不给定）：质量通量就是给定的 ρ∞u∞·n，整个对流通量只经 Tf 依赖单元的状态，不加 Roe 耗散。粘性通量与原处理相同：沿中心到面点取两点差，面点上 u、v、ν̃ 是来流值；没有热流；能量里的功 u∞·τn 与动量用同一个 τn。h → 0 时粘性通量把 u、v、ν̃ 固定在来流值，质量通量把 ρ 带进区域。附录 B 说明为什么这样是伴随一致的，而 Roe 通量对虚拟状态不是。出口面：面状态的对流通量，压力换成 p∞ = 1，能量通量里是 p∞u·n（牵引力做的功），没有粘性通量。

An inflow face's convective flux is the physical flux F(Wbc)·n of the boundary state Wbc = (ρ∞, u∞, v∞, Tf, ν̃∞), Tf being the face state's own temperature (T is not prescribed): the mass flux is the given ρ∞u∞·n, the whole convective flux depends on the cell's state through Tf only, and there is no Roe dissipation. The viscous flux is the original one: the two-point difference from the centre to the face point, where u, v and ν̃ are the free stream's; no heat flux; and the work u∞·τn in the energy row uses the momentum's own τn. As h → 0 the viscous flux holds u, v and ν̃ at the free stream, and the mass flux carries ρ into the domain. Appendix B explains why this is adjoint-consistent and the Roe flux against a ghost state is not. An outlet face: the face state's convective flux with its pressure replaced by p∞ = 1, p∞u·n in the energy flux (the work of the traction), and nothing viscous.

在解处冻结的分支

The branches, frozen at the solution

离散残差里有几处不可导点。导数（前向、伴随、复数步长）都在当前解所在的那一侧分支上取；只要解离分支点足够远，差分的步长就跨不过去。下表列出二阶格式在收敛解处的距离：

The discrete residual has a few points where it is not differentiable. Every derivative (tangent, adjoint, complex step) is taken on the branch the solution sits on; as long as the solution is far enough from a switch, a finite-difference step cannot cross it. The table lists the distances at the converged second-order solution:

分支branch当前解处的余量margin at the solution

修正分支在 8 个控制体上起作用，r 在 7 个控制体上被截断：两个分支都真的在用。

The modified branch is active in 8 control volumes and r is capped in 7: both branches are really in use.

第 4 节Section 4

残差 = 几遍循环：原始变量、梯度、面、源项

The residual = passes: primitives, gradients, faces, source

标量页面的残差是一个面循环。这里一个面要读两侧的梯度，而梯度要读整个模板的值，所以残差分成几遍：先把所有控制体的原始变量算出来，再算所有梯度，然后才是面通量和源项。

On the scalar pages the residual is one face loop. Here a face reads the gradients on both sides, and a gradient reads the values over its whole stencil, so the residual comes in passes: first the primitive variables of every control volume, then every gradient, and only then the face fluxes and the source.

W=π(U),G=ΓW,R(U)=F(W,G)−S(W,G,d)

π 在每个控制体上独立地把守恒变量换成原始变量；Γ 是线性的最小二乘算子（权重只依赖几何）；F 是面通量的装配，S 是源项。下面的演示逐句执行这几遍：410 步，可以用上方的按钮直接跳到某一遍。

π turns each control volume's conserved variables into primitives, independently; Γ is the linear least-squares operator (its weights depend on the geometry only); F assembles the face fluxes and S the source. The demo below executes the passes statement by statement: 410 steps, and the buttons above it jump straight to a pass.

图 4.2Figure 4.2

最后一步 max|R| 在舍入误差量级：U* 是收敛解。

At the last step max|R| is at round-off: U* is the converged solution.

第 5 节Section 5

求解：Jacobian、近似 Jacobian 与 Gauss–Seidel

The solve: the Jacobian, the approximate Jacobian and Gauss–Seidel

从残差到 Jacobian

From the residual to the Jacobian

A = ∂R/∂U 是 120×120 的矩阵，由 5×5 的块组成。一个面的通量读两侧的值与梯度，梯度又读整个模板，所以 A 的一行不只连到邻居，还连到邻居的邻居：200 个非零块。

A = ∂R/∂U is a 120×120 matrix of 5×5 blocks. A face's flux reads the values and gradients on both sides, and a gradient reads its whole stencil, so a row of A reaches past the neighbours to the neighbours' neighbours: 200 non-zero blocks.

近似 Jacobian：一阶 Roe 加薄剪切层

The approximate Jacobian: first-order Roe plus the thin shear layer

Gauss–Seidel 用的不是 A，而是一个只连接面两侧的近似 P：对流部分是一阶 Roe（Jc(U) = ∂(Fc(U)·n̂)/∂U 是物理通量的 Jacobian，|J̃c| = Σk|Λk|rklkT 是它在两侧中心状态的 Roe 平均处取绝对值，lk 是左特征向量），粘性部分是薄剪切层（只保留修正梯度沿 Δx 的两点差分，系数冻结）：

Gauss–Seidel does not use A but an approximation P that couples only the two sides of each face: first-order Roe for the convective part (Jc(U) = ∂(Fc(U)·n̂)/∂U is the Jacobian of the physical flux, and |J̃c| = Σk|Λk|rklkT its absolute value at the Roe average of the two centre states, lk being the left eigenvectors), and the thin shear layer for the viscous part (only the two-point difference along Δx of the corrected gradient, with frozen coefficients):

∂Φf∂UL≈12(Jc(UL)+∣J~c∣)∣n∣+Θf∂W∂U∣L∂Φf∂UR≈12(Jc(UR)−∣J~c∣)∣n∣−Θf∂W∂U∣R

Θf 是薄剪切层矩阵乘上两点系数 θf = nf·Δx/|Δx|²：动量行 θfμe(I + ⅓n̂n̂T)，能量行加上功与导热 θfke，ν̃ 行 θfρa。对角块再加上 SA 源项对 ρν̃ 的导数中使对角增强的那一部分（耗散），以及伪时间项 V/Δt。P 有 88 个非零块。

Θf is the thin-shear-layer matrix times the two-point coefficient θf = nf·Δx/|Δx|²: the momentum rows θfμe(I + ⅓n̂n̂T), the energy row adds the work and the conduction θfke, and the ν̃ row θfρa. The diagonal blocks also receive the part of the SA source's derivative with respect to ρν̃ that strengthens the diagonal (the destruction), and the pseudo-time term V/Δt. P has 88 non-zero blocks.

逐步推导：薄剪切层矩阵从哪里来

Step by step: where the thin-shear-layer matrix comes from

第一步，只留两点部分。在第 2 节的面梯度里只保留沿 Δx 的两点差，∇fφ ≈ (φR − φL)Δx/|Δx|²，并冻结所有系数。于是速度的面梯度矩阵是 ∇fu ≈ Δu ΔxT/|Δx|²（Δu = uR − uL）。

Step 1, keep only the two-point part. In the face gradient of Section 2 keep only the two-point difference along Δx, ∇fφ ≈ (φR − φL)Δx/|Δx|², and freeze every coefficient. The velocity's face-gradient matrix is then ∇fu ≈ Δu ΔxT/|Δx|² (Δu = uR − uL).

第二步，代入应力：

Step 2, put it into the stress:

τn≈μe∣Δx∣2[Δ𝐮 (Δx⋅n)+Δx (Δ𝐮⋅n)−23 (Δ𝐮⋅Δx) n]

第三步，Δx 平行于 n 时。Δx = |Δx|n̂、n = |n|n̂，两点系数 θf = n·Δx/|Δx|² = |n|/|Δx|，第二步化为

Step 3, when Δx is parallel to n. With Δx = |Δx|n̂ and n = |n|n̂, the two-point coefficient is θf = n·Δx/|Δx|² = |n|/|Δx|, and Step 2 becomes

τn≈θf μe[Δ𝐮+n^ (n^⋅Δ𝐮)−23 (n^⋅Δ𝐮) n^]=θf μe(I+13 n^n^T)Δ𝐮

第四步，能量与 ν̃ 两行。功 uavg·τn 用第三步的 τn，导热与 ν̃ 的扩散也只剩两点差（unavg = uavg·n̂）：

Step 4, the energy and ν̃ rows. The work uavg·τn uses Step 3's τn, and the conduction and the ν̃ diffusion keep their two-point differences only (unavg = uavg·n̂):

𝐮avg⋅τn+ke∇ ⁣fT⋅n≈θf[μe(𝐮avg+13unavgn^)⋅Δ𝐮+ke ΔT],ρa ∇ ⁣fν~⋅n≈θf ρa Δν~

第五步，Θf。把三式按原始变量 (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃) 排成矩阵，就是第 5 节的 Θf：Fv ≈ Θf(WR − WL)，∂Fv/∂UR ≈ ΘfΠR，∂Fv/∂UL ≈ −ΘfΠL（Π = ∂W/∂U，第 7 节）。Δx 不平行于 n 时（歪斜的面），第二步里 Δx(Δu·n) 与 (Δu·Δx)n 两项不再化成 n̂n̂T：Θf 只是近似。P 本来只需要近似：它只影响迭代的快慢。

Step 5, Θf. Arranging the three in the primitive columns (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃) gives Section 5's Θf: Fv ≈ Θf(WR − WL), ∂Fv/∂UR ≈ ΘfΠR, ∂Fv/∂UL ≈ −ΘfΠL (Π = ∂W/∂U, Section 7). When Δx is not parallel to n (a skewed face), the terms Δx(Δu·n) and (Δu·Δx)n of Step 2 no longer reduce to n̂n̂T: Θf is an approximation. P only needs to be one: it affects how fast the iteration converges, nothing else.

核对：把本页每个内部面的 Δx 转到 n 的方向、两侧取同一状态、梯度取零，粘性核的磁带给出的 ∂Fv/∂WR 与第三、四步的 Θf 相差 3.8×10−16（相对 Frobenius 范数）。本页的面并不正交：32 个内部面上 Δx 与 n 的夹角平均 17.9°，最大 40.1°（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: with the line Δx of every interior face of this page turned along n, the same state on both sides and zero gradients, the viscous kernel's taped ∂Fv/∂WR and the Θf of Steps 3 and 4 differ by 3.8×10−16 (relative, Frobenius norm). This page's faces are not orthogonal: over the 32 interior faces the angle between Δx and n is 17.9° on average and 40.1° at most (computed by this page's code at build time).

P 与 A 差多少？图 5.2 在一个面上比较磁带给出的直接块（一阶面状态、梯度固定，第 2 节 Roe 与粘性线性化的全部项）与 P 的块（第 2 节 Roe 第五步的前两项加上面的 Θf）。

How far is P from A? Figure 5.2 compares, on one face, the taped direct block (first-order face states, gradients held, every term of Section 2's linearisations of the Roe and viscous fluxes) with P's block (the first two terms of Step 5 of Section 2's Roe derivation plus the Θf above).

R(U) = 0 怎样解

How R(U) = 0 is solved

用第 2 节的半离散方程 V dU/dt = −R(U) 做伪时间推进。记 ΔU = Uk+1 − Uk，每一步用隐式（后向 Euler）格式，并把 R 在当前状态线性化：

March the semi-discrete equation of Section 2, V dU/dt = −R(U), in pseudo time. With ΔU = Uk+1 − Uk, each step is implicit (backward Euler), with R linearised about the current state:

V ΔUΔt=−R(Uk+ΔU)≈−R(Uk)−A ΔU

把 AΔU 移到左边，就是每一步要解的线性方程：

Moving AΔU to the left gives the linear system of each step:

(VΔt+A)ΔU=−R(Uk)

V/Δt 是对角的：每个控制体取自己的伪时间步 Δti，由局部 CFL 数和该控制体的对流、粘性谱半径决定，所以各处推进的“时间”并不相同。把 A 换成近似 Jacobian Â，左边就是上面的 P；再用两次对称块 GS 近似求解，就是本页的迭代：

V/Δt is diagonal: each control volume takes its own pseudo-time step Δti, set by a local CFL number and the control volume's convective and viscous spectral radii, so different places advance by different amounts of “time”. Replacing A by the approximate Jacobian Â turns the left-hand side into the P above; solving with it approximately, by two symmetric block GS sweeps, gives this page's iteration:

Uk+1=Uk−K R(Uk),K=two symmetric block Gauss–Seidel sweeps on P=VΔt+A^

一次对称扫描是 i = 1…N 的前扫接 N…1 的回扫；每个控制体解一个 5×5 的块方程，用到的是邻居最新的值。CFL 从 5 起按残差下降放大，上限 200；每 50 步检查一次，若这 50 步里最小的残差没有比此前最好的值再低 10%，就把上限减半（不低于 10），大步长下偶尔出现的伪时间二周期由此消失。一个 5×5 块的求逆就是全部的“线性代数”，不形成、不分解大矩阵。

One symmetric sweep is a forward pass over i = 1…N followed by a backward pass over N…1; each control volume solves a 5×5 block equation with its neighbours' latest values. The CFL number starts at 5 and grows as the residual falls, capped at 200; every 50 steps, if the smallest residual of those 50 is not 10 % below the best before, the cap is halved (down to 10), which settles the pseudo-time two-cycle that a large step occasionally produces. Inverting a 5×5 block is all the “linear algebra” there is: no large matrix is formed or factorised.

伪时间步只进 P（从而进 K），不进 R：它决定迭代怎样走、走多快，不改变终点。收敛时 R(U*) = 0，与 Δt、Â 和扫描次数都无关；本节开头的 A = ∂R/∂U 也不含时间项，所以第 7、8 节的前向与伴随方程 A v = −f、ATψ = −g 里也没有时间项。第 9、10 节迭代求解它们时用的也是这个 P，它同样只影响收敛的快慢。推进中还有一道保正：若整步会让某个控制体的 ρ 或 T 变化超过 20%，或让 ν̃ 变负，就按比例缩短这个控制体的步长；它也只改变路径。

The pseudo-time step enters P (and so K), not R: it decides how the iteration travels and how fast, not where it ends. At convergence R(U*) = 0 whatever Δt, Â and the number of sweeps; the A = ∂R/∂U at the start of this section carries no time term either, so neither do the tangent and adjoint equations of Sections 7 and 8, A v = −f and ATψ = −g. The iterations that solve them in Sections 9 and 10 use this P as well, and there too it only sets how fast they converge. The marching also keeps the state positive: if a full step would change a control volume's ρ or T by more than 20%, or make its ν̃ negative, that control volume's step is shortened in proportion; this too changes only the path.

第 6 节Section 6

目标函数：阻力系数

The objective: the drag coefficient

CD=𝐅⋅eDq∞,eD=(cos⁡α,sin⁡α),q∞=12ρ∞U∞2=0.7M2

F 是流体作用在物体上的力。格心页上它就是所有壁面面的动量通量之和：弱条件的通量本身就是壁面上的压力减去粘性应力。

F is the force the fluid exerts on the body. On the cell page it is the sum of the wall faces' momentum fluxes: the weak condition's flux is itself the wall pressure minus the viscous stress.

粗网格的阻力有多准

How accurate the coarse-mesh drag is

同一个问题在第 1、2 级加密网格（每级把每个单元一分为四）上的阻力：

The drag of the same problem on the meshes of levels 1 and 2 (each level divides every cell into four):

级level控制体control volumesCD
0245.9162
1966.2830
23846.4102

第 0 级的阻力与第 2 级相差 8%：这张教学网格只有 8 个面贴着物体。附录 A 把两种格式都算到第 4 级：格心 6.414，格点 6.456，两者还差 0.7%。从第 0 级到第 4 级，本页的 CD 变化 +8.4%，三个导数：dCD/dα +0.41%、dCD/dM −18%、dCD/dμref +35%；其中对 M、μref 的导数比阻力变得多（第 11 节、附录 A）。本页关心的是离散问题的导数：它在每一级网格上都是那一级离散问题的精确导数，但第 0 级的值不能当作连续问题导数的近似。

The level-0 drag differs from level 2's by 8%: this teaching mesh has only 8 faces on the body. Appendix A takes both schemes to level 4: cell 6.414, node 6.456, still 0.7% apart. From level 0 to level 4 this page's CD changes by +8.4%, and its three derivatives: dCD/dα by +0.41%, dCD/dM by −18%, dCD/dμref by +35%; the derivatives with respect to M and μref change more than the drag (Section 11 and Appendix A). What this page is about is the derivative of the discrete problem: on every mesh it is the exact derivative of that mesh's discrete problem, but the level-0 value must not be taken as an approximation of the continuous problem's derivative.

伴随方程的右端项

The right-hand side of the adjoint equation

g = ∂CD/∂U 是伴随方程 ATψ = −g 的右端。它只在贴壁单元（及其最小二乘模板里的单元）上非零。本页用目标函数的一条局部磁带反向扫描一次得到它：种子 CˉD=1，扫描返回的 Uˉ 就是 g。

g = ∂CD/∂U is the right-hand side of the adjoint equation ATψ = −g. It is non-zero only on the wall cells (and the cells in their least-squares stencils). This page gets it from one reverse sweep of a tape of the objective: with the seed CˉD=1 the sweep returns Uˉ=g.

逐步推导：CD 的偏导数

Step by step: the partial derivatives of CD

第 7 节的 dCD/dp = ∂CD/∂p + ψTf 里，∂CD/∂p 是固定 U 时的偏导数。对三个流动参数它们都有闭式。

In Section 7's dCD/dp = ∂CD/∂p + ψTf, ∂CD/∂p is the partial derivative at fixed U. For the three flow parameters it has a closed form.

第一步，F 与参数。CD = F·eD/q∞。格心页的 F 是壁面面的动量通量之和：壁面压力来自贴壁单元的重构，应力来自它的修正梯度。α 与 M 只进入来流数据，而壁面面不碰来流，所以固定 U 时 F 与 α、M 无关；μref 进入粘性应力。

Step 1, F and the parameters. CD = F·eD/q∞. On the cell page F is the sum of the wall faces' momentum fluxes: the wall pressure comes from the wall cells' reconstruction, the stress from their corrected gradient. α and M enter the inflow data only, and no wall face touches the inflow, so at fixed U, F does not depend on α or M; μref enters the viscous stress.

第二步，α。deD/dα = (−sin α, cos α) = eL，与来流垂直，所以固定流场时转动来流方向，阻力的变化就是升力系数：

Step 2, α. deD/dα = (−sin α, cos α) = eL, perpendicular to the free stream, so turning the free-stream direction with the flow held changes the drag by the lift coefficient:

∂CD∂α∣U=𝐅⋅eLq∞=CL

第三步，M。q∞ = 0.7M²，dq∞/dM = 2q∞/M：

Step 3, M. q∞ = 0.7M², dq∞/dM = 2q∞/M:

∂CD∂M∣U=−𝐅⋅eDq∞2 dq∞dM=−2 CDM

第四步，μref。F 里依赖 μref 的只有粘性应力 τn，它对 μe 是线性的。μ = μref·1.4T1.5/(T + 0.4) 与 μref 成正比；μt = ρν̃fv1(χ) 经 χ = ρν̃/μ 依赖它：

Step 4, μref. The only part of F that depends on μref is the viscous stress τn, which is linear in μe. μ = μref·1.4T1.5/(T + 0.4) is proportional to μref; μt = ρν̃fv1(χ) depends on it through χ = ρν̃/μ:

∂μ∂μref=μμref,∂μt∂μref=ρν~fv1′ ∂χ∂μref=−ρν~ χfv1′μref,∂(τn)∂μref=τnμe ∂μe∂μref

格心页把它加在每个壁面面上（μe 是贴壁单元与壁面点的平均，壁面上 μt = 0）：

The cell page sums it over the wall faces (μe averaged between the wall cell and the wall point, with μt = 0 on the wall):

∂CD∂μref∣U=−eDq∞⋅∑f∈wallτnμe  μavg−12∑ρν~ χfv1′μref

没有涡粘性时，这就是 CD 的粘性部分除以 μref：固定流场时粘性应力与 μref 成正比。涡粘性使它变小：固定 ν̃ 时 μref 增大，χ 减小，μt 也减小。

Without eddy viscosity this is the viscous part of CD divided by μref: with the flow held, the viscous stress is proportional to μref. The eddy viscosity lowers it: at fixed ν̃ a larger μref means a smaller χ and a smaller μt.

第五步，g = ∂CD/∂U。F 读哪些状态，g 就在哪些控制体上非零：壁面压力 ρwTw 读贴壁单元与它 ρ、T 模板里的邻居，壁面应力读贴壁单元的修正梯度，也就是它 u、v 模板里的邻居。图 6.2 画出 g。

Step 5, g = ∂CD/∂U. g is non-zero exactly in the control volumes whose state F reads: the wall pressure ρwTw reads the wall cell and the neighbours of its ρ, T stencil, and the wall stress reads the wall cell's corrected gradient, that is, the neighbours of its u, v stencil. Figure 6.2 draws g.

Check: on this page CL = −0.763937, and the whole-residual tape gives ∂CD/∂α|U = −0.763937, a relative difference of 0; −2CD/M = −59.1621 against the tape's −59.1621, 1.2×10−16; Step 4's sum is 109.2569 against the tape's 109.2569, 3.9×10−16. g is non-zero in 16 control volumes (computed by this page's code at build time).

第 7 节Section 7

matrix-free 前向：计算 R˙=AU˙

Matrix-free forward mode: computing R˙=AU˙

为什么需要 A 与 AT 的乘积

Why products with A and AT are needed

对任何设计变量 p（迎角、马赫数、参考粘度、每个节点坐标），

For any design variable p (the angle of attack, the Mach number, the reference viscosity, each node coordinate),

dCDdp=∂CD∂p+gTv,Av=−f,f=∂R∂p⟺dCDdp=∂CD∂p+ψTf,ATψ=−g

前向每个 p 解一次，伴随解一次就得到所有 p 的导数。两种迭代都只需要一个动作：R˙=AU˙（residual_d）或 Uˉ=ATRˉ（residual_b）。

The tangent needs one solve per p, the adjoint one solve for all of them. Both iterations need only one action: R˙=AU˙ (residual_d) or Uˉ=ATRˉ (residual_b).

记号：点与横线

Notation: the dot and the bar

从这里起，对离散代码的求导都用自动微分的记号（Griewank 与 Walther）：x˙ 是程序变量 x 的前向（切线）导数，xˉ 是它的反向（伴随）导数；反向把语句倒过来执行，累加写作 xˉ+=…，前向里被覆盖的量清零，xˉ←0。两个求解的结果沿用本页的名字 v 与 ψ：

From here on, every derivative of the discrete code is written in the notation of algorithmic differentiation (Griewank and Walther): x˙ is the forward (tangent) derivative of a program variable x, xˉ its reverse (adjoint) derivative; reverse mode runs the statements backwards, accumulating, xˉ+=…, and zeroing what the forward code overwrote, xˉ←0. The two solves keep this page's names, v and ψ:

v≡U˙  (p˙=1):C˙D=∂CD∂p+gTv=dCDdpRˉ=ψ:Uˉ=ATψ=−g,pˉ=∂CD∂p+ψTf=dCDdpRˉTR˙=UˉTU˙(R˙=AU˙,  Uˉ=ATRˉ)

pˉ 的显式部分 ∂CD/∂p 来自目标的反向扫描（种子 CˉD=1；第 6 节的 g 就是这种扫描对 U 给出的 Uˉ）。最后一行是对偶恒等式：第 8 节的点积检验在随机向量上核对它，第 10 节前向与伴随的导数估计逐步相等是它在迭代上的形式。

The explicit part ∂CD/∂p of pˉ comes from a reverse sweep of the objective with CˉD=1 (Section 6's g is the Uˉ of such a sweep). The last line is the duality identity: the dot-product test of Section 8 checks it on random vectors, and the equal derivative estimates of the tangent and the adjoint iterations in Section 10 are its form along the iterations.

点、横线与 δ 各有其位。点与横线是离散代码的前向与反向导数（第 7–13、15 节与各节的逐步推导）；代码与演示用 Tapenade 的名字，x_d ≡ x˙、x_b ≡ xˉ：residual_d 返回 R_d = A·U_d，residual_b 返回 U_b = AT·R_b。δ 是连续函数的变分，只出现在附录 A 的连续伴随里。

The dot, the bar and δ each have their place. The dot and the bar are the forward- and reverse-mode derivatives of the discrete code (Sections 7–13 and 15, and the step-by-step derivations); the code and the demos use Tapenade's names, x_d ≡ x˙ and x_b ≡ xˉ: residual_d returns R_d = A·U_d, residual_b returns U_b = AT·R_b. δ is the variation of a continuous function and appears only in the continuous adjoint of Appendix A.

对局部核求导：局部磁带

Differentiating the local kernels: local tapes

残差由三种核拼成：原始变量 π（每个控制体 5 进 5 出）、面核（内部面读两侧的 W 与 G，共 30 个输入、5 个输出）、源项核（15 进 1 出）。每个核只写一次，同一份代码可以用实数、复数或“局部磁带”运行。磁带记下核里每个运算的值与它对一两个操作数的偏导数；向前扫一遍得到方向导数，向后扫一遍得到转置。本页在 U* 处对每个核录一次磁带（一个内部面最多 1032 个节点），反向扫 5 次得到它的 5×30 局部 Jacobian Jf。

The residual is built from three kinds of kernel: the primitives π (5 in, 5 out per control volume), the face kernel (an interior face reads W and G on both sides: 30 inputs, 5 outputs), and the source kernel (15 in, 1 out). Each kernel is written once, and the same code runs on real numbers, on complex numbers, or on a “local tape”. The tape records every operation's value and its partial derivatives with respect to its one or two operands; a forward sweep gives a directional derivative, a reverse sweep the transpose. This page tapes each kernel once at U* (at most 1032 nodes for an interior face) and sweeps it backwards 5 times for its 5×30 local Jacobian Jf.

装配：同样的几遍

Assembly: the same passes

W˙=Π U˙,G˙=Γ W˙,Φ˙f=Jf(W˙[L]W˙[R]G˙[L]G˙[R]),R˙=AU˙=∑f±Φ˙f+∑iJs,i(W˙[i]G˙[i])

为什么这正是 AU˙

Why this is exactly AU˙

链式法则：R = F(W, G) − S(W, G, d)，W = π(U)，G = ΓW，所以

The chain rule: R = F(W, G) − S(W, G, d), W = π(U), G = ΓW, hence

A=(∂F∂W−∂S∂W)Π+(∂F∂G−∂S∂G)Γ Π

演示最后一步把循环的结果 R_d 与显式的 A·U_d 相比（A 由 120 次同样的 residual_d 逐列拼出，只为对照）。随机向量的点积检验（第 8 节）也验证了这一点：两者之差 3.6×10−16（构建页面时算的，用的是第 8 节演示打开时那一组随机向量）。

The last step of the demo compares the loop's result R_d with the explicit product A·U_d (A assembled column by column from 120 calls of this same residual_d, for the comparison only). The dot-product test on random vectors (Section 8) confirms it too: a difference of 3.6×10−16 (computed when the page was built, with the pair of random vectors the demo of Section 8 opens with).

逐步推导：原始变量的 Jacobian Π

Step by step: the Jacobian Π of the primitives

第一步，写出 π。W = π(U)：ρ = U1，u = U2/U1，v = U3/U1，ν̃ = U5/U1；由 ρE = ρ(cvT + ½|u|²)，

Step 1, write π out. W = π(U): ρ = U1, u = U2/U1, v = U3/U1, ν̃ = U5/U1; from ρE = ρ(cvT + ½|u|²),

T=1cv(U4U1−U22+U322U12)

第二步，逐行求导。例如 ∂T/∂U1 = (−U4/U1² + (U2² + U3²)/U1³)/cv = (u² + v² − E)/(ρcv)：

Step 2, differentiate row by row. For example ∂T/∂U1 = (−U4/U1² + (U2² + U3²)/U1³)/cv = (u² + v² − E)/(ρcv):

Π=∂W∂U=(10000−u/ρ1/ρ000−v/ρ01/ρ00u2+v2−Eρcv−uρcv−vρcv1ρcv0−ν~/ρ0001/ρ)

第三步，结构。Π 是下三角矩阵，对角元 1、1/ρ、1/ρ、1/(ρcv)、1/ρ 在 ρ > 0 时都不为零，所以它可逆。前向的第 0 遍是每个控制体一次 W˙=ΠU˙，伴随的最后一步是 Uˉ+=ΠTWˉ；ΠT 是上三角的，Uˉ 的 ρ 分量收集 Wˉ 全部五个分量的贡献。

Step 3, the structure. Π is lower triangular, and its diagonal 1, 1/ρ, 1/ρ, 1/(ρcv), 1/ρ never vanishes for ρ > 0, so it is invertible. Pass 0 of the tangent is W˙=ΠU˙ once per control volume, and the last step of the adjoint is Uˉ+=ΠTWˉ; ΠT is upper triangular, and the ρ component of Uˉ gathers contributions from all five components of Wˉ.

核对：在 U* 的每个控制体上，上面的 Π 与 model.js prim() 的磁带相差 4.3×10−16（相对）（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: in every control volume of U*, the Π above and the tape of model.js prim() differ by 4.3×10−16 (relative) (computed by this page's code at build time).

第 8 节Section 8

matrix-free 伴随：计算 Uˉ=ATRˉ

Matrix-free adjoint mode: computing Uˉ=ATRˉ

转置一个乘积要把因子倒过来、每个因子转置。反向把第 7 节的几条语句倒过来执行，从种子 Rˉ 出发：

Transposing a product reverses the factors and transposes each. Reverse mode runs the statements of Section 7 backwards, from the seed Rˉ:

Gˉ=(∂F∂G−∂S∂G)TRˉWˉ=(∂F∂W−∂S∂W)TRˉ+ΓTGˉUˉ=ΠTWˉ=ATRˉ
  • 面与源项的转置：原来“写 R[L]、R[R]”的地方变成“读 Rˉ[L]−Rˉ[R]”，一个 5 维权重经 JfT 变成 30 个，累加到 Wˉ 与 Gˉ 上。The transpose of the faces and the source: where R[L] and R[R] were written, Rˉ[L]−Rˉ[R] is read, and one 5-vector of weights becomes 30 through JfT, accumulated into Wˉ and Gˉ.
  • 最小二乘的转置 ΓT：前向里梯度从整个模板收集，伴随里梯度的权重送回整个模板（每个模板点加，自己减）。The transpose of the least squares, ΓT: in the tangent a gradient gathers from its whole stencil, in the adjoint the gradient's weight is sent back to its whole stencil (added at each stencil point, subtracted at its own).
  • 原始变量的转置 ΠT：每个控制体一个 5×5 转置乘法，累加到 Uˉ 上。The transpose of the primitives, ΠT: one 5×5 transposed product per control volume, accumulated into Uˉ.

第 9 节Section 9

前向求解：A v = −f

The forward solve: A v = −f

前向方程用原始迭代的同一个 K 求解：

The tangent equation is solved with the same K as the primal iteration:

vk+1=vk−K (Avk+f),v0=0

K 是 U* 处的两次对称 Gauss–Seidel（CFL 固定在 200），A v 是第 7 节的 residual_d 取 U_d = v。原始迭代在接近 U* 时的误差也按 I − KA 传播，所以两者的渐近速率相同，都是迭代矩阵 I − KA 的谱半径：二阶格式 ρ(I − KA) = 0.802（幂迭代测得）。在残差从初值的 10−4 降到 10−11 的区间里拟合的每步因子是：原始 0.806、前向 0.801，与 ρ(I − KA) 的相对差 +0.46%、−0.12%。拟合区间有限，残差在其中并不是严格的等比数列，所以拟合值可以略高或略低于 ρ(I − KA)。f = ∂R/∂p：迎角与马赫数只进入来流数据 u∞ = M√γ(cos α, sin α)（出口的 p∞ = 1 与它们无关）；μref 进入 μ(T)、来流的 ν̃∞ = 3μref，以及所有粘性与源项。

K is two symmetric Gauss–Seidel sweeps at U* (with the CFL number fixed at 200), and A v is Section 7's residual_d with U_d = v. Near U* the primal iteration's error also propagates by I − KA, so the two share the same asymptotic rate, the spectral radius of the iteration matrix I − KA: ρ(I − KA) = 0.802 for the second-order scheme (measured by power iteration). Fitted over the band where each residual falls from 10−4 to 10−11 of its start, the factors per iteration are 0.806 (primal) and 0.801 (tangent), +0.46% and −0.12% from ρ(I − KA). Over a finite band the residual is not an exact geometric sequence, so a fitted factor can lie a little above or below ρ(I − KA). f = ∂R/∂p: the angle of attack and the Mach number enter only the inflow data u∞ = M√γ(cos α, sin α) (the outlet's p∞ = 1 does not depend on them); μref enters μ(T), the inflow's ν̃∞ = 3μref, and every viscous and source term.

图 9.1Figure 9.1

结果：二阶格式 dCD/dα = −1.32040853、dCD/dM = −15.255679、dCD/dμref = 158.76422。它们与第 10 节伴随给出的值相对差 3.4×10−15（除以 |∂CD/∂p|、|ψTf| 与 |dCD/dp| 中最大的一个，见下）；直接除以导数本身是 3.4×10−15。

The result: for the second-order scheme dCD/dα = −1.32040853, dCD/dM = −15.255679, dCD/dμref = 158.76422. They differ from the adjoint's values of Section 10 by a relative 3.4×10−15 (over the largest of |∂CD/∂p|, |ψTf| and |dCD/dp|, see below); over the derivative itself the difference is 3.4×10−15.

本页比较流动参数的导数时，相对差默认除以三个量中最大的一个：显式部分 |∂CD/∂p|、伴随部分 |ψTf|（等于前向的 |gTv|）与导数本身 |dCD/dp|。本页 dCD/dM = ∂CD/∂M + ψTf = −59.162 + 43.906 = −15.2557：两部分部分抵消，和只有较大部分的 1/4。舍入误差随两部分的大小走，不随它们的和走，所以除以和会把它放大约 4 倍；按两部分归一量的是舍入误差真正所在的量级。第 10、12、13 节与各演示用同一个归一，并同时给出除以导数本身的值；坐标导数没有两部分之分，直接除以导数本身（或按范数，见第 13 节）。

When this page compares derivatives with respect to the flow parameters, a relative difference is by default divided by the largest of three sizes: the explicit part |∂CD/∂p|, the adjoint part |ψTf| (equal to the tangent's |gTv|) and the derivative itself |dCD/dp|. On this page dCD/dM = ∂CD/∂M + ψTf = −59.162 + 43.906 = −15.2557: the two parts partly cancel, and the sum is 1/4 of the larger part. Round-off scales with the parts, not with their sum, so dividing by the sum inflates it about 4 times; normalising by the parts measures it at the size where it actually lives. Sections 10, 12 and 13 and the demos use the same normalisation and also give the difference over the derivative itself; the coordinate derivatives have no such parts and are divided by the derivative itself (or taken normwise, Section 13).

第 10 节Section 10

伴随求解：Aᵀψ = −g

The adjoint solve: Aᵀψ = −g

ψk+1=ψk−KT (ATψk+g),ψ0=0

KT 不需要另外编程：在 PT 上做同样的对称扫描，正好就是 K 的转置。把 P 按控制体编号分成块对角 D、严格下三角 P< 与严格上三角 P>。从零开始的一次对称扫描（前扫接回扫）是线性算子 K1：前扫解 (D + P<)x' = b，回扫解 (D + P>)x = b − P<x'，合起来

KT needs no separate code: the same symmetric sweeps on PT are exactly the transpose of K. Split P, in the numbering of the control volumes, into its block diagonal D, its strictly lower block triangle P< and its strictly upper block triangle P>. One symmetric sweep from zero (forward then backward) is a linear operator K1: the forward pass solves (D + P<)x' = b, the backward pass (D + P>)x = b − P<x', and together

K1(P)=(D+P>)−1D (D+P<)−1,K1(P)T=(DT+P<T)−1DT(DT+P>T)−1=K1(PT)

因为 PT 的块对角是 DT、严格下三角是 P>T、严格上三角是 P<T。本页的 K 是两次扫描：第二次从第一次的结果 x1 = K1b 出发，x2 = x1 + K1(b − Px1)，所以

since the block diagonal of PT is DT, its strictly lower triangle P>T and its strictly upper triangle P<T. This page's K is two sweeps: the second starts from the first one's result x1 = K1b, x2 = x1 + K1(b − Px1), so

K=2K1−K1PK1,KT=2K1T−K1TPTK1T=2K1(PT)−K1(PT) PT K1(PT)

这正是在 PT 上做两次同样的对称扫描（扫描次数更多时同理：k 次扫描是 Σj<k(I − K1P)jK1，它的转置是 PT 上的同一个和）。代码里 precond(P, b, 2, transposed) 正是这样：transposed 时每个对角块与邻居块都取转置，扫描顺序不变。二阶格式随机向量上 ⟨a, Kb⟩ 与 ⟨KTa, b⟩ 的相对差 6.1×10−16（构建时测得）。于是伴随迭代与前向迭代在每一步都给出同一个导数估计：从零开始，

That is exactly two of the same symmetric sweeps on PT (and so for any number of sweeps: k sweeps are Σj<k(I − K1P)jK1, whose transpose is the same sum on PT). The code precond(P, b, 2, transposed) does just that: transposed, every diagonal and neighbour block is transposed and the sweep order stays. On random vectors ⟨a, Kb⟩ and ⟨KTa, b⟩ differ by a relative 6.1×10−16 for the second-order scheme (measured at build time). So the adjoint and the tangent iterations give the same derivative estimate at every iteration: started from zero,

gTvk=−∑j<kgT(I−KA)jKf=−∑j<kgTK(I−AK)jf=(ψk)Tf

下面的动画逐行执行一次 K 与一次 KT：两边解的行顺序相同，用到的块位置也相同，只是 PT 的第 i 行取的是 P 的第 i 列、每块转置；表里是前几步的两个导数估计。

The animation below executes one K and one KT row by row: both solve the rows in the same order and use blocks at the same places, except that row i of PT takes column i of P, every block transposed; the table gives the two derivative estimates over the first iterations.

The adjoint meets its criterion at iteration 141, with a fitted factor of 0.803 over the same band (+0.15% from ρ(I − KA)). The three iterations (primal, tangent, adjoint) share the asymptotic rate ρ(I − KA) = 0.802: the adjoint's iteration matrix I − KTAT is the transpose of I − AK, and I − AK has the spectrum of I − KA. ψ 的每个分量是对应方程残差的灵敏度：把某个控制体某个方程的残差加上一个小量 ε（Rk → Rk + ε），CD 改变 ψkε。

Each component of ψ is the sensitivity to the residual of its equation: adding a small ε to the residual of one equation of one control volume (Rk → Rk + ε) changes CD by ψkε.

下面的动画把两个迭代放在一起：左边是原始的伪时间迭代从来流状态走向 U*，右边是伴随迭代从 ψ = 0 走向 ψ。伴随迭代用 U* 处的 P；原始迭代每步在当前状态重新组装 P，CFL 从 5 放大到上限 200。接近 U* 时两者的 P 相同，误差按同一个速率 ρ(I − KA) 衰减，残差曲线的斜率也就相同。

The adjoint iteration uses the P at U*; the primal one reassembles P at the current state every step, with the CFL number growing from 5 to its cap of 200. Near U* the two use the same P, their errors decay at the same rate ρ(I − KA), and the residual curves have the same slope.

逐步推导：一次对称扫描为什么是 x + K1(b − Px)

Step by step: why one symmetric sweep is x + K1(b − Px)

上面用了“第二次扫描从 x1 出发得到 x1 + K1(b − Px1)”。它对任何起点 x 都成立，推导如下。

Above, the second sweep from x1 was taken to give x1 + K1(b − Px1). This holds from any starting point x; here is why.

第一步，前扫。第 i 行用前面已经更新的值与后面的旧值，(D + P<)x′ = b − P>x。两边减去 (D + P<)x：

Step 1, the forward pass. Row i uses the values already updated before it and the old values after it, (D + P<)x′ = b − P>x. Subtract (D + P<)x from both sides:

(D+P<)(x′−x)=b−(P<+D+P>) x=b−Px⟹x′=x+(D+P<)−1(b−Px)

第二步，回扫。同理 (D + P>)x″ = b − P<x′ 给 x″ = x′ + (D + P>)−1(b − Px′)。

Step 2, the backward pass. In the same way (D + P>)x″ = b − P<x′ gives x″ = x′ + (D + P>)−1(b − Px′).

第三步，合起来。由第一步，b − Px′ = (I − P(D + P<)−1)(b − Px)；再把 I 写成 (D + P<)(D + P<)−1，并用 P = P< + D + P>：

Step 3, combine. By Step 1, b − Px′ = (I − P(D + P<)−1)(b − Px); write I as (D + P<)(D + P<)−1 and use P = P< + D + P>:

x′′−x=[(D+P<)−1+(D+P>)−1(I−P(D+P<)−1)](b−Px)=(D+P>)−1[(D+P>)+(D+P<)−P](D+P<)−1(b−Px)=(D+P>)−1D (D+P<)−1(b−Px)=K1 (b−Px)

第四步，两次扫描与转置。从 x = 0 出发，x1 = K1b，x2 = x1 + K1(b − Px1) = (2K1 − K1PK1)b = Kb。转置把三个因子倒过来：K1T = (DT + P<T)−1DT(DT + P>T)−1，最右边、最先作用的 DT + P>T 正是 PT 的块对角加严格下三角：PT 上仍是先前扫、再回扫，上面的动画一行一行地演示了这一点。

Step 4, two sweeps and the transpose. From x = 0, x1 = K1b and x2 = x1 + K1(b − Px1) = (2K1 − K1PK1)b = Kb. Transposing reverses the three factors: K1T = (DT + P<T)−1DT(DT + P>T)−1, and the rightmost factor, applied first, DT + P>T, is exactly the block diagonal plus the strictly lower triangle of PT: on PT it is still a forward pass first and a backward pass second, which the animation above shows row by row.

核对：把本页的 P 写成 120×120 的稠密矩阵，由它算出的 2K1 − K1PK1 与代码的 K（对 120 个单位向量各做一次 precond）相差 3.3×10−15；transposed 扫描得到的矩阵与 KT 相差 6.8×10−16；从随机的 x 做一次扫描，与 x + K1(b − Px) 相差 1.3×10−15（都相对最大元）（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: with this page's P written as a dense 120×120 matrix, the 2K1 − K1PK1 computed from it and the code's K (one precond per unit vector, 120 of them) differ by 3.3×10−15; the matrix of the transposed sweeps and KT differ by 6.8×10−16; one sweep from a random x and x + K1(b − Px) differ by 1.3×10−15 (all relative to the largest entry) (computed by this page's code at build time).

第 11 节Section 11

几何导数：dCD/dX

Geometric derivatives: dCD/dX

dCDdX=∂CD∂X+ψT∂R∂X

坐标经几何量进入残差：面法向 n、面点 xf（重构沿 xf − xi 外推）、中心与连线 Δx、体积 V、最小二乘权重（依赖中心位置）、壁面距离（依赖中心与最近的壁面边）。ψT∂R/∂X 是固定 U* 时对残差的一次反向扫描：本页把几何那一遍也写在同一套运算上，录一条包括几何的磁带（25316 个节点），用 ψ 作种子（Rˉ=ψ）反向扫一次，得到 Xˉ=(∂R/∂X)Tψ 与 pˉ=(∂R/∂p)Tψ；同一条磁带以 CˉD=1 再扫一次给出显式部分，两者之和就是全部 48 个坐标与 3 个流动参数的导数。

The coordinates enter the residual through the geometry: the face normals n, the face points xf (the reconstruction extrapolates along xf − xi), the centres and the lines Δx, the volumes V, the least-squares weights (which depend on the centres), and the wall distances (on the centre and the nearest wall edge). ψT∂R/∂X is one reverse sweep of the residual at fixed U*: this page writes the geometric pass on the same arithmetic, tapes the residual including the geometry (25316 nodes) and sweeps it backwards once with ψ as the seed (Rˉ=ψ), which gives Xˉ=(∂R/∂X)Tψ and pˉ=(∂R/∂p)Tψ; one more sweep of the same tape with CˉD=1 gives the explicit parts, and the two sums are the derivatives for all 48 coordinates and the 3 flow parameters.

不会失败的结构检验

Structural checks that cannot fail

三个恒等式只依赖离散格式的不变性，与流动无关（这里都是全导数 d）：整体平移不改变任何东西，ΣidCD/dxi = ΣidCD/dyi = 0；整体旋转等价于反向转动来流，Σi(xidCD/dyi − yidCD/dxi) = −dCD/dα；长度与 μref 同时放大同一个倍数，CD（以固定参考长度 1 归一）也放大同一个倍数，ΣX·dCD/dX + μrefdCD/dμref = CD。构建页面时在 Node.js 里测得的残差：平移 1.8×10−14、旋转 3.6×10−14、伸缩 1.5×10−14；下面演示里的表是你的浏览器重算的，舍入误差不同，末位会不一样，但都在 10−13 以下。

Three identities depend only on the invariances of the discrete scheme, not on the flow (all total derivatives d here): a rigid translation changes nothing, ΣidCD/dxi = ΣidCD/dyi = 0; a rigid rotation is the same as turning the free stream the other way, Σi(xidCD/dyi − yidCD/dxi) = −dCD/dα; scaling the lengths and μref together by the same factor scales CD (normalised by the fixed reference length 1) by that factor, ΣX·dCD/dX + μrefdCD/dμref = CD. The residuals measured in Node.js when the page was built: translation 1.8×10−14, rotation 3.6×10−14, scaling 1.5×10−14; the table in the demo below is recomputed in your browser, whose round-off differs, so the last digits differ too, all below 10−13.

图 11.2Figure 11.2

演示里每个箭头是移动一个节点时 CD 的变化率。只有壁面节点的移动改变物体的形状；内部与远场节点的移动只改变网格，CD 仍会变，因为离散解依赖网格。要得到对物体形状的梯度，还需要一条网格变形链：给物面形状参数 s，先把壁面的位移传给所有节点，X = X(s)，再用链式法则 dCD/ds = (dCD/dX)(dX/ds)。本页只算到 dCD/dX，不含网格变形。

Each arrow of the demo is the rate of change of CD as one node moves. Only the moves of the wall nodes change the body's shape; moving an interior or far-field node changes only the mesh, and CD still changes because the discrete solution depends on the mesh. A gradient with respect to the body's shape needs a mesh-deformation chain as well: for shape parameters s of the wall, carry the wall's displacement to every node, X = X(s), and apply the chain rule dCD/ds = (dCD/dX)(dX/ds). This page stops at dCD/dX, with no mesh deformation.

流动参数的导数（演示最后一行）也是第 0 级离散问题的精确导数，但离连续问题的导数可能很远。附录 A 把格心格式加密到第 4 级：dCD/dα = −1.326，连续伴随给出 −1.416。这不是导数算错了（第 12、13 节把它核对到舍入误差），而是第 0 级网格离连续问题太远。

The derivatives with respect to the flow parameters (the demo's last line) are exact derivatives of the level-0 discrete problem too, but may be far from the continuous problem's. Appendix A refines the cell scheme to level 4: dCD/dα = −1.326, and the continuous adjoint gives −1.416. The derivative is not wrong (Sections 12 and 13 check it to round-off); the level-0 mesh is simply far from the continuous problem.

逐步推导：dCD/dX 经过哪些几何量

Step by step: which geometric quantities dCD/dX passes through

第一步，几何那一遍的输出。几何那一遍把节点坐标 X 变成七个存储数组 𝒢 = (nf, xf, Δx, xi, Vi, Γij, di)：面法向、面点、中心连线、中心、体积、最小二乘权重、壁面距离。残差与目标只通过它们读 X：R = R(U, 𝒢(X))，CD = CD(U, 𝒢(X))。

Step 1, the outputs of the geometric pass. The geometric pass turns the node coordinates X into seven stored arrays 𝒢 = (nf, xf, Δx, xi, Vi, Γij, di): face normals, face points, centre lines, centres, volumes, least-squares weights and wall distances. The residual and the objective read X through them only: R = R(U, 𝒢(X)), CD = CD(U, 𝒢(X)).

第二步，链式法则。固定 U*，每个数组 𝒢k 先收集它自己的伴随权重，再经几何那一遍的 Jacobian 回到 X：

Step 2, the chain rule. With U* held, each array 𝒢k first gathers its own adjoint weight, then goes back to X through the Jacobian of the geometric pass:

dCDdX=∑k=17(∂𝒢k∂X)T𝒢ˉk,𝒢ˉk=∂CD∂𝒢k+(∂R∂𝒢k)Tψ

第三步，两次反向扫描。第一次把残差与目标录在以 𝒢 为输入的磁带上，种子是 CˉD=1 与 Rˉ=ψ，一次得到全部 𝒢ˉk；第二次把几何那一遍录在以 X 为输入的磁带上，分别用每个 𝒢ˉk 作种子，得到它的那一份。七份之和就是第 11 节开头那一次反向扫描的结果（那里两条磁带是连在一起录的）。七份各有多大，见图 11.3。

Step 3, two reverse sweeps. The first tapes the residual and the objective with 𝒢 as the inputs and sweeps back with the seeds CˉD=1 and Rˉ=ψ, which gives every 𝒢ˉk at once; the second tapes the geometric pass with X as the input and sweeps back with each 𝒢ˉk as the seed, which gives that array's share. The seven shares sum to the result of the single reverse sweep at the start of Section 11 (where the two tapes are recorded as one). Figure 11.3 shows how large the seven shares are.

第四步，几个 ∂𝒢/∂X 的例子。格心页的面法向 nf = (yb − ya, xa − xb) 对端点坐标是常数矩阵；单元体积按鞋带公式 V = ½Σk(xkyk+1 − xk+1yk)，∂V/∂xk = ½(yk+1 − yk−1)、∂V/∂yk = ½(xk−1 − xk+1)；最小二乘权重见第 2 节的第六步，壁面距离见第 1 节的第三至第五步。

Step 4, some ∂𝒢/∂X. On the cell page a face normal nf = (yb − ya, xa − xb) has a constant derivative with respect to its end points; a cell's volume by the shoelace formula V = ½Σk(xkyk+1 − xk+1yk) has ∂V/∂xk = ½(yk+1 − yk−1) and ∂V/∂yk = ½(xk−1 − xk+1); the least-squares weights are Step 6 of Section 2 and the wall distances Steps 3 to 5 of Section 1.

核对：七份之和与第 11 节的 dCD/dX 相差 1.6×10−15（相对最大分量）；‖dCD/dX‖ = 10.998（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: the seven shares sum to Section 11's dCD/dX to 1.6×10−15 (relative to the largest entry); ‖dCD/dX‖ = 10.998 (computed by this page's code at build time).

第 12 节Section 12

验证：与有限差分对照

Verification against finite differences

中心差分 [CD(p + ε) − CD(p − ε)]/(2ε) 每个设计变量要重算两次流场，每次都从 U* 出发、收敛到舍入底。步长 ε 太大，截断误差 ∝ ε²；ε 太小，重算解残留的舍入误差被 1/ε 放大。二阶格式的步长扫描（与伴随的相对差；α 一列按第 9 节的归一，另一列除以导数本身）：

The central difference [CD(p + ε) − CD(p − ε)]/(2ε) re-solves the flow twice per design variable, each time from U* down to the round-off floor. With the step ε too large the truncation error ∝ ε² dominates; with ε too small the round-off left in the re-solved flows is amplified by 1/ε. The step sweep for the second-order scheme (relative difference from the adjoint; for α one column in the normalisation of Section 9 and one over the derivative itself):

10−33.3×10−73.3×10−72.6×10−6

10−52.3×10−92.3×10−91.9×10−8

10−71.9×10−71.9×10−71.8×10−6

截断误差按 ε² 下降，α 在 ε = 10−5、节点 1 的 x 在 ε = 10−5 处与舍入误差相遇：最好的差分与伴随的相对差，α 为 2.3×10−9（除以导数本身 2.3×10−9），节点 1 的 x 为 1.9×10−8。最低点的具体数值取决于重算解的舍入误差，换一台机器、换一个浏览器都会略有不同（下面的演示在本机重算）。差分只能验证到这个量级；更严格的核对由复数步长（第 13 节）给出。

The truncation error falls as ε² and meets the round-off at ε = 10−5 for α and ε = 10−5 for x of node 1: the best difference agrees with the adjoint to a relative 2.3×10−9 for α (2.3×10−9 over the derivative itself) and 1.9×10−8 for x of node 1. The exact value at the minimum depends on the round-off of the re-solved flows and varies a little from machine to machine and browser to browser (the demo below re-solves here). A difference can verify no further than this; the complex step (Section 13) gives the stricter check.

第 13 节Section 13

复数步长

The complex step

怎样实现

How to implement it

同一份核代码换上复数算术：加减乘直接算，除法用 Smith 算法（不会溢出，虚部很小时实部与实数除法逐位相同），sqrt、exp、实数次幂取主值；|x|、min、max 与所有分支（S̃ 的两支、r 的截断、壁面距离的最近边与垂足位置、Roe 的 |Λk|）都只看实部。步长 ε = 10−30 时虚部比实部小约 30 个数量级，两个虚部的乘积小约 60 个数量级，永远碰不到实部的最后一位：每个实部都与实数代码逐位相同。

The same kernel code on complex arithmetic: addition, subtraction and multiplication as they are; division by Smith's algorithm (it never overflows, and with tiny imaginary parts its real part is bit for bit the real division); sqrt, exp and real powers on their principal branches; |x|, min, max and every branch (the two branches of S̃, the cap on r, the nearest wall edge and the foot position, Roe's |Λk|) read the real part only. With the step ε = 10−30 the imaginary parts stay about 30 orders of magnitude below the real ones and a product of two imaginary parts about 60, which never reaches the last bit of a real part: every real part is bit for bit the real code's.

从收敛的流场出发

Starting from the converged flow

把设计变量换成 p + iε，从 U* + 0i 出发，用同一个 K 迭代 U ← U − K R(U)。实部停在 U*；虚部的方程是

Replace the design variable by p + iε, start from U* + 0i, and iterate U ← U − K R(U) with the same K. The real part stays at U*; the imaginary part obeys

Im⁡Uk+1ε=Im⁡Ukε−K(A Im⁡Ukε+f)

这正是前向迭代：Im Uk/ε 就是 vk。二阶格式前 40 次迭代上，Im CD/ε 与前向估计的最大相对差 2.4×10−14（按第 9 节的归一；除以导数本身 2.4×10−14）。收敛后复数步长与伴随的相对差：3 个流动参数 1.7×10−14（按第 9 节的归一；除以导数本身 1.7×10−14），48 个坐标（按范数：最大差除以最大导数）6.1×10−15。

This is exactly the tangent iteration: Im Uk/ε is vk. Over the first 40 iterations of the second-order scheme, Im CD/ε and the tangent estimate differ by at most 2.4×10−14 (in the normalisation of Section 9; 2.4×10−14 over the derivative itself). Once converged, the complex step agrees with the adjoint to a relative 1.7×10−14 for the 3 flow parameters (in the normalisation of Section 9; 1.7×10−14 over the derivatives themselves), and to 6.1×10−15 for the 48 coordinates (normwise: the largest difference over the largest derivative).

第 14 节Section 14

精度阶：制造解检验

Order of accuracy: manufactured solutions

伴随给出的是离散格式的精确导数，与格式本身几阶精度无关；格式的精度阶决定的是离散解，以及由它算出的 CD 与导数，离连续问题有多远。附录 A 的制造解只检验连续伴随的 P1 求解器；这一节检验本页的有限体积格式本身，一字不改：Roe 通量、无权最小二乘重构、SU2 式修正平均梯度的粘性通量、TMR 守恒形式的 SA（含 ft2、2012 年修正的 S̃、r ≤ 10 的截断与密度梯度项）、Sutherland 粘度，格心与格点、一阶与二阶。做法是：先选光滑的函数当精确解，由它反推出源项，再在一族逐级一致加密的网格上求解，看误差随网格尺寸按几次方减小。

The adjoint gives the exact derivative of the discrete scheme, whatever the scheme's order of accuracy; the order decides how far the discrete solution, and the CD and derivatives computed from it, are from the continuous problem. The manufactured solution of Appendix A tests only the continuous adjoint's P1 solver; this section tests the page's finite-volume scheme itself, exactly as implemented: the Roe flux, unweighted least-squares reconstruction, SU2's corrected average gradient for the viscous flux, SA in TMR's conservative form (ft2, the 2012 modified S̃, the cap r ≤ 10 and the density-gradient term included), Sutherland's viscosity; cell and node, first and second order. The method: choose smooth functions as the exact solution, derive the source that makes them one, solve on a family of uniformly refined meshes, and see by what power of the mesh size the error falls.

两个构造解

Two manufactured solutions

两个解的 ρ、u、v、T 相同，ν̃ 不同：

The two solutions share ρ, u, v and T, and differ in ν̃:

ρe=2sin⁡(9x10+310)cos⁡(7y10−15)25+1,Te=3cos⁡(x2+3y5+15)50+1
ue=−3y50+sin⁡(7x10+y2+310)50+625,ve=3x50+cos⁡(3x5−4y5+110)50+3100
ν~e R=3sin⁡(4x5−2y5+12)1000+1100,ν~e M=21sin⁡(4x5−2y5+12)1000+750

μref 取本页的 0.02。它们的涡量 ∂ve/∂x − ∂ue/∂y 在 [0.098, 0.129] 之间，处处同号，所以 Ω = |ω| 是光滑的。两个解各把 SA 的分支固定在整个区域：

μref is the page's 0.02. Their vorticity ∂ve/∂x − ∂ue/∂y lies in [0.098, 0.129], one sign everywhere, so Ω = |ω| is smooth. Each solution keeps the SA branches fixed over the whole domain:

  • R（常规分支）：χ 在 [0.33, 0.69]，fv2 > 0，所以 B > 0，S̃ = Ω + B 处处是第一支，r ≤ 1/fv2 处处小于 10，不截断。ft2 很大（在 [0.94, 1.14]），μt/μ 很小（最大 6.5×10−4）：这个解检验 fv2、ft2 与完整的 fw(r)。R (the regular branch): χ in [0.33, 0.69], fv2 > 0, so B > 0 and S̃ = Ω + B is the first branch everywhere, and r ≤ 1/fv2 stays below 10: never capped. ft2 is large (in [0.94, 1.14]) and μt/μ small (at most 6.5×10−4): this solution tests fv2, ft2 and the whole fw(r).
  • M（修正分支）：χ 在 [5.40, 8.60]，fv2 < 0，B < −c2Ω 处处成立，S̃ 处处取 2012 年的修正分支，r 处处截断在 10。μt/μ 在 [1.65, 5.50]：涡粘性主导平均流，这个解检验 μt 对动量与能量方程的耦合。M (the modified branch): χ in [5.40, 8.60], fv2 < 0, and B < −c2Ω holds everywhere, so S̃ takes the 2012 modified branch everywhere and r is capped at 10 everywhere. μt/μ lies in [1.65, 5.50]: the eddy viscosity drives the mean flow, and this solution tests the coupling of μt into the momentum and energy equations.

余量在两处量：一处是各级网格上所有求源项的中心（第 1–5 级，两种格式），一处是整个区域里的 144720 个点（从物体中心出发的 720 条射线，每条从壁面到远场 201 个点，最近的离壁面只有间隙的万分之一）。都是正数，分支在整个区域里都没有切换：

The margins are measured in two ways: at every centre where the source is evaluated on every level (levels 1–5, both schemes), and at 144720 points over the whole domain (720 rays from the body's centre, 201 points each from the wall to the far field, the first a ten-thousandth of the gap from the wall). All are positive: no branch switches anywhere in the domain:
