Roe 通量里的 |q̃| 是唯一避不开的不可导点：面的朝向遍布各个方向，总有面几乎与流速平行。|q̃| 只出现在耗散项里，乘的是两侧状态的跳跃（二阶 O(h²)、一阶 O(h)），它是 Lipschitz 连续的，不影响精度，只影响可导性，而这一节不求导。

Roe's |q̃| is the one kink that cannot be avoided: the faces point in every direction, and some face is always nearly parallel to the flow. |q̃| appears only in the dissipation, multiplying the jump between the two states (O(h²) at second order, O(h) at first), and it is Lipschitz: it affects differentiability, not accuracy, and this section takes no derivatives.

源项与边界

The source and the boundaries

把精确解代入第 2 节的方程，对连续通量求散度，再减去 SA 源项：

Put the exact solution into the equations of Section 2, take the divergence of the continuous fluxes, and subtract the SA source:

s(x)=∇⋅(𝐅c(We)−𝐅v(We,∇We))−S(We,∇We,d),Ri(U)  ←  Ri(U)−Vi s(xi)

s 由 sympy 对解析的通量逐项求导得到（mms_gen.py），从不调用离散残差。壁面距离 d 只以代数方式进入 S，所以 s 在每个控制体中心用格式自己的 di 求值；积分用格式自己的单点规则（与 SA 源项相同），xi 是单元顶点的平均点。sympy 的源项与本页代码的通量公式互相核对过：在任取的点上用四阶中心差分对 model.js 的通量求散度，两者在差分截断与舍入误差内一致（check_mms.js）。为了只检验内部离散，这一节把精确解加在所有边界上（core.js 的 mms 模式；本页其余各节的边界条件不变）：每个边界面都取对精确解的通量：Roe 通量的右侧是面中点的精确状态，粘性通量取中心到面点的两点差（含热流，功用边界速度），与第 3 节的来流面同一写法；贴壁单元最小二乘模板里的壁面点取精确的 u、v、ν̃（ρ、T 仍只用邻居）。

s comes from sympy differentiating the analytic fluxes term by term (mms_gen.py), never from the discrete residual. The wall distance d enters S algebraically only, so s is evaluated at every control volume's centre with the scheme's own di; the integral takes the scheme's own one-point rule (the SA source's), xi being the vertex average of the cell. The sympy source and this page's flux formulas were checked against each other: at arbitrary points, the divergence of model.js's fluxes by fourth-order central differences agrees with the sympy source within the differences' truncation and round-off (check_mms.js). To test the interior discretisation alone, this section imposes the exact solution on every boundary (core.js's mms mode; the boundary conditions of the rest of the page are untouched): every boundary face takes the flux against the exact solution: the Roe flux with the exact state at the face midpoint on its right, and the viscous flux of the two-point difference from the centre to the face point (heat flux included, the work of the boundary velocity), written like Section 3's inflow face; the wall point in a wall cell's least-squares stencil carries the exact u, v, ν̃ (ρ and T still use the neighbours only).

网格族与误差

The mesh family and the error

第 1–5 级网格由第 0 级逐级一致细分得到（每个三角形由三条边的中点分成 4 个，每个四边形由四条边的中点与顶点平均点分成 4 个），物面与远场都是直边八边形，每一级的计算域完全相同，网格尺寸逐级减半。误差与各自的未知量比较：格心格式的 Ui 是单元平均，与精确解守恒量的单元平均比较（每个三角形 36 点 Gauss 积分，四边形分成两个三角形）；格点格式的 Ui 是节点值，与精确的节点值比较。用体积加权的 L2 范数；网格尺寸逐级减半，所以观测阶 p 就是相邻两级误差之比以 2 为底的对数。每一级都解到第 5 节的判据（先用本页的伪时间迭代 40 步，没到判据再用 Newton–GMRES 收尾），迭代误差远小于离散误差。

Levels 1–5 come from level 0 by uniform subdivision (a triangle into 4 through its edge midpoints, a quadrilateral into 4 through its edge midpoints and vertex average); the body and the far field are straight-sided octagons, so every level covers exactly the same domain and the mesh size halves from level to level. The error is measured against each scheme's own unknowns: the cell scheme's Ui is a cell average, compared with the cell average of the exact conserved variables (a 36-point Gauss rule per triangle, a quadrilateral split into two); the node scheme's Ui is a nodal value, compared with the exact nodal value. The norm is the volume-weighted L2 norm; the mesh size halves from level to level, so the observed order p is the base-2 logarithm of the ratio of the errors on neighbouring levels. Every level is solved to the criterion of Section 5 (40 steps of this page's pseudo-time iteration, then Newton–GMRES where the criterion is not met yet), so the iteration error is far below the discretisation error.

结果

What the numbers say

  • 二阶格式：五个分量的观测阶在 1.73–2.12 之间；低于 1.8 的只有解 R 上格心格式的 ρ（逐级 2.07、1.71、1.65、1.73），其余在 1.86–2.12 之间，都在 2 附近。质量方程只有对流、没有扩散；下一条说明，纯对流问题在三角形网格上的收敛阶可以低于格式的形式精度。Second order: the observed orders of the five components lie between 1.73 and 2.12; the only ones below 1.8 are the cell scheme's ρ on solution R (2.07, 1.71, 1.65, 1.73 level by level), and the rest lie between 1.86 and 2.12, all near 2. The mass equation has convection and no diffusion; the next item shows that on triangular meshes a purely convective problem can converge more slowly than the scheme's formal order.
  • 一阶格式：动量分量的观测阶在 0.87–0.95 之间；密度、能量与 ρν̃ 在 0.69–0.86 之间，都明显低于 1。与前一段相比，后三者的阶变化了 −0.02 到 +0.12，有升有降，这些网格还定不下它们的渐近阶。质量方程只有对流、没有扩散；ρu、ρv、ρE、ρν̃ 的误差分别含有 u e(ρ)、v e(ρ)、E e(ρ)、ν̃ e(ρ) 一项（例如 e(ρu) ≈ u e(ρ) + ρ e(u)），除非两项相消，它们最终不会比 e(ρ) 收敛得快。纯对流问题上，迎风型格式在三角形网格上的收敛阶可以低于形式精度：Peterson（1991）构造了一族三角形网格，一阶迎风格式（零次间断 Galerkin）在其上对纯对流问题只有 h1/2。本页一阶格式的观测阶都在 1/2 与 1 之间。First order: the momentum components converge at orders between 0.87 and 0.95; the density, the energy and ρν̃ between 0.69 and 0.86, all clearly below 1. From the previous pair of levels the orders of these three changed by between −0.02 and +0.12, some rising and some falling, so these meshes do not settle their asymptotic orders. The mass equation has convection and no diffusion; the errors of ρu, ρv, ρE and ρν̃ contain the terms u e(ρ), v e(ρ), E e(ρ) and ν̃ e(ρ) (for example e(ρu) ≈ u e(ρ) + ρ e(u)), so unless the two terms cancel they cannot in the end converge faster than e(ρ). On purely convective problems an upwind-type scheme can converge on triangular meshes more slowly than its formal order: Peterson (1991) constructed a family of triangular meshes on which the first-order upwind scheme (discontinuous Galerkin of degree zero) converges only as h1/2 on a purely convective problem. At first order every observed order here lies between 1/2 and 1.
  • 目标函数 CD（二阶格式）：解 R 上格心格式的误差逐级为 −5.8×10−3、−1.4×10−3、−1.6×10−4、4.3×10−5、3.0×10−5，在第 3、4 级之间变号。变号说明误差里至少有两部分符号相反、随 h 减小的快慢不同；变号的那一段没有阶，紧接着的一段里两部分仍在相消，观测阶也不代表收敛速率。最后两级的观测阶（不计受变号影响的）在 1.86–2.03 之间。格心格式在壁面上的剪应力用单元梯度与中心到面点的两点差，单个面上只有 O(h) 精度；本页格式测得的阻力阶为 1.86（解 M），高于 1，说明在解 M 上这一 O(h) 部分还不是阻力误差的主要部分。The objective CD (second order): the cell scheme's error on solution R is −5.8×10−3, −1.4×10−3, −1.6×10−4, 4.3×10−5, 3.0×10−5 level by level, changing sign between levels 3 and 4. A sign change means that the error has at least two parts of opposite sign that shrink at different rates with h; the pair of levels across the sign change has no order, and in the pair right after it the two parts still cancel, so its observed order does not measure a convergence rate either. The observed orders between the last two levels (leaving out those affected by a sign change) lie between 1.86 and 2.03. The cell scheme's wall shear stress uses the cell gradient and the two-point difference from the centre to the face point, only O(h) accurate on a single face; this page's scheme measures drag orders of 1.86 (solution M), above 1, so on solution M this O(h) part is not yet the main part of the drag error.
  • 对伴随的意义：第 7–13 节核对的是伴随给出离散 CD 的精确导数，与格式几阶无关；这一节测的是这个离散问题以多快的速度趋于连续问题。两者都是离散导数趋于连续问题导数的前提；这个收敛本身在附录 A 里直接比较。What this means for the adjoint: Sections 7–13 check that the adjoint gives the exact derivative of the discrete CD, whatever the scheme's order; this section measures how fast the discrete problem approaches the continuous one. Both are prerequisites for the discrete derivatives to approach the continuous problem's; that convergence itself is compared directly in Appendix A.

范围：这里检验的是光滑解在固定多边形区域上的内部离散。真实算例的来流与出口交界点、物面角点与不可分辨的来流薄层（附录 A.6、B.6）不在检验范围内；它们可能让真实算例收敛得比这里慢。

Scope: what is tested here is the interior discretisation on a smooth solution over a fixed polygonal domain. The junctions of inflow and outlet, the corners of the body and the unresolved inflow sublayer of the real case (Appendices A.6 and B.6) are outside the test; they can make the real case converge more slowly than the orders found here.

第 15 节Section 15

伴随方程的三种解法：GS、GMRES 与 LU

Three solvers for the adjoint equation: GS, GMRES and LU

第 10 节用不动点迭代 ψk+1 = ψk − KT(ATψk + g) 解伴随方程。它每步便宜（一次 AT 乘积、两次对称扫描），但收敛速率由 ρ(I − KA) 决定：本页二阶格式 ρ(I − KA) = 0.802，要 141 步才满足判据。这一节在同一个系统 ATψ = −g（120 个未知量）上比较三种解法；它们解的是同一个方程，所以给出同一个 ψ、同一组导数，差别只在怎样到达那里。

Section 10 solves the adjoint equation by the fixed point ψk+1 = ψk − KT(ATψk + g). Each step is cheap (one product with AT, two symmetric sweeps), but the rate is set by ρ(I − KA): for this page's second-order scheme ρ(I − KA) = 0.802, and the criterion takes 141 steps. This section compares three solvers on the same system ATψ = −g (120 unknowns); they solve the same equation, so they give the same ψ and the same derivatives, and differ only in how they get there.

  • GS 不动点（第 10 节）：沿 KT 给出的方向一步一步修正。只要 ρ(I − KA) < 1 就收敛，误差每步乘约 ρ(I − KA)。The GS fixed point (Section 10): corrections along the directions KT gives, one at a time. It converges whenever ρ(I − KA) < 1, the error shrinking by about ρ(I − KA) per step.
  • GMRES，以同一个 KT 作右预处理：保存已经产生的方向 KTv0, KTv1, …，在它们张成的空间里取使残差 ‖ATψ + g‖ 最小的组合（Arnoldi 正交化加一个小最小二乘问题）。每步也是一次 AT 乘积、一次 KT，外加正交化；不需要 ρ(I − KA) < 1（不重启时，AT 非奇异就在 n 步内收敛）。本页每 30 步重启一次，限制存储。GMRES, right-preconditioned by the same KT: it keeps the directions produced so far, KTv0, KTv1, …, and takes the combination in their span that minimises the residual ‖ATψ + g‖ (Arnoldi orthogonalisation plus a small least-squares problem). Each step is again one product with AT and one KT, plus the orthogonalisation; it does not need ρ(I − KA) < 1 (without restarts it converges within n steps whenever AT is nonsingular). This page restarts every 30 steps to bound the storage.
  • 直接 LU 分解：把 AT 显式装配出来（用 120 次 residual_d 取出 A 的各列，再转置），做带部分主元的 Gauss 消元 ΠAT = LU，再做两次三角回代。没有迭代，精度只受舍入误差限制；代价是 n² = 14400 个数的存储与约 n³/3 次乘法，而且它不是 matrix-free 的。对这张 24 个控制体的网格毫无问题；每加密一级 n 乘 4，存储乘 16，工作量乘 64，在实际网格上不可行。A direct LU factorisation: assemble AT explicitly (the columns of A from 120 calls of residual_d, then transposed), eliminate with partial pivoting, ΠAT = LU, and solve two triangular systems. No iteration, accuracy limited by round-off only; the price is storing n² = 14400 numbers, about n³/3 multiplications, and giving up the matrix-free form. On this mesh of 24 control volumes that is no problem at all; each level of refinement multiplies n by 4, the storage by 16 and the work by 64, which rules it out on practical meshes.

构建页面时测得的结果（与 GS 不动点的导数比较；按第 9 节的归一，括号里是除以导数本身）：

Measured when the page was built (derivatives compared with the GS fixed point's; in the normalisation of Section 9, over the derivatives themselves in brackets):

迭代步数（AT 乘积）iterations (products with AT)14169 (73)— (120)
最终残差 ‖ATψ + g‖（均方根）final residual ‖ATψ + g‖ (rms)6.8×10−157.2×10−141.0×10−14
导数与 GS 的最大相对差largest relative difference of the derivatives from GS—5.2×10−14 (5.2×10−14)2.9×10−15 (1.1×10−14)
一阶格式：迭代步数first order: iterations3921—

三种解法给出的导数在舍入误差内相同。GMRES 的步数更少（69 对 141），因为它不只沿最新的方向走，而是在所有已产生的方向里挑最好的组合：GS 迭代里衰减得慢、接近 ρ(I − KA) 的那几个误差分量，GMRES 几步就能把它们一起消掉。它的代价是每步的正交化与 30 个基向量的存储。LU 的装配本身就要 120 次 residual_d，比 GMRES 的 73 次乘积多，外加 O(n³) 的分解；它的用处是给迭代解法一个不依赖迭代的参照。

The three solvers give the same derivatives to round-off. GMRES needs fewer steps (69 against 141): it does not just follow the latest direction but picks the best combination of all directions produced so far, and the few error components that the GS iteration damps slowly, near ρ(I − KA), it removes together within a few steps. Its price is the orthogonalisation per step and the storage of 30 basis vectors. LU's assembly alone takes 120 calls of residual_d, more than GMRES's 73 products, plus the O(n³) factorisation; its use is a reference for the iterative solvers that involves no iteration at all.

总结

Summary

做什么what怎样做how
residual(U)R(U)R(U)几遍循环：π、Γ、面、源项passes: π, Γ, faces, source
residual_d(U, U_d)R˙=AU˙R˙=AU˙同样的几遍、同样的顺序，核换成局部 Jacobianthe same passes in the same order, kernels replaced by local Jacobians
residual_b(U, R_b)Uˉ=ATRˉUˉ=ATRˉ几遍倒序，每遍转置the passes reversed, each transposed
solveR(U) = 0R(U) = 0伪时间 + 两次对称块 GS（P = 一阶 Roe + 薄剪切层）pseudo-time + two symmetric block GS sweeps (P = first-order Roe + thin shear layer)
tangentA v = −fA v = −f同一个 K，每个设计变量一次the same K, once per design variable
adjointAᵀψ = −gAᵀψ = −gKᵀ = PT 上的同一个 SGS，一次得到全部导数Kᵀ = the same SGS on PT, all derivatives at once
complex stepIm C_D / εIm C_D / ε从 U* 出发、同一个 K，虚部就是前向迭代from U*, the same K: the imaginary part is the tangent iteration
FD[C_D(p+ε) − C_D(p−ε)]/2ε[C_D(p+ε) − C_D(p−ε)]/2ε每个变量两次重算，精度受步长限制two re-solves per variable, accuracy limited by the step
MMS‖U − U_e‖ ∝ h^p‖U − U_e‖ ∝ h^p第 14 节：两个制造解、第 1–5 级网格；本页格式二阶 p = 1.73–2.01，一阶 0.70–0.95Section 14: two manufactured solutions, levels 1–5; this page's scheme p = 1.73–2.01 at second order, 0.70–0.95 at first
GMRES, LUAᵀψ = −gAᵀψ = −g第 15 节：同一个方程、同一组导数；GMRES 69 步，GS 141 步Section 15: the same equation, the same derivatives; GMRES in 69 steps, GS in 141
continuousλ = (λ_ρ, β, ζ, φ)λ = (λ_ρ, β, ζ, φ)附录 A：连续伴随方程与边界条件，P1 有限元求解；加密时导数与 ψ 给出的相互靠近Appendix A: the continuous adjoint equations and boundary conditions, solved by P1 finite elements; under refinement its derivatives approach ψ's
  • 离散伴随只需要两样东西：每个局部核的转置（局部磁带反向扫描）和各遍的倒序。多遍结构（原始变量、梯度、面、源项）完全保留。The discrete adjoint needs only two things: the transpose of each local kernel (a reverse sweep of its local tape) and the passes in reverse order. The pass structure (primitives, gradients, faces, source) is kept entirely.
  • 最小二乘让 A 的一行伸到邻居的邻居；伴随里对应的是梯度的权重回到整个模板。近似 Jacobian 只要一阶连接，Gauss–Seidel 与它的转置都只用 P。The least squares makes a row of A reach the neighbours' neighbours; in the adjoint this is a gradient's weight returning to its whole stencil. The approximate Jacobian needs first-order coupling only, and Gauss–Seidel and its transpose use P alone.
  • 对称 Gauss–Seidel 的转置就是在 PT 上的同一个算法：前向与伴随在每一步给出同一个导数估计，三个迭代共用一个收敛速率。The transpose of symmetric Gauss–Seidel is the same algorithm on PT: the tangent and the adjoint give the same derivative estimate at every iteration, and the three iterations share one rate.
  • 导数在当前解所在的分支上取；本页的解离所有分支点都足够远（第 3 节）。复数步长与伴随的相对差：流动参数 1.7×10−14（按第 9 节的归一；除以导数本身 1.7×10−14），48 个坐标（按范数）6.1×10−15。Derivatives are taken on the branch the solution sits on; this page's solution is far enough from every switch (Section 3). The complex step and the adjoint differ by a relative 1.7×10−14 for the flow parameters (in the normalisation of Section 9; 1.7×10−14 over the derivatives themselves), and by 6.1×10−15 (normwise) for the 48 coordinates.
  • 伴随的精确性与格式的精度是两件事：第 14 节用制造解测得本页格式的阶，第 15 节说明换一种线性解法（GMRES、LU）只改变到达同一个 ψ 的路径。The exactness of the adjoint and the accuracy of the scheme are two things: Section 14 measures this page's order with manufactured solutions, and Section 15 shows that another linear solver (GMRES, LU) changes only the path to the same ψ.
  • 一阶／二阶开关只改变对流通量的面状态；两种格式的伴随都用同一套代码，验证结果相同。The first/second-order switch changes only the face states of the convective flux; both schemes' adjoints run on the same code, with the same verification.
  • 离散伴随是离散问题的精确导数；它是否趋于连续问题的导数是另一个问题。附录 A 推导并独立求解连续伴随：加密到第 4 级，两种离散伴随与连续伴随给出的导数相互靠近，但相邻两级之比没有稳定在 h2 的 1/4；连续问题在来流与出口交界点、物面角点上有奇性（附录 A.6）。The discrete adjoint is the exact derivative of the discrete problem; whether it approaches the derivative of the continuous problem is another question. Appendix A derives and independently solves the continuous adjoint: refined to level 4, the derivatives from the two discrete adjoints and from the continuous adjoint approach each other, though the ratio between neighbouring levels does not settle at h2's quarter; the continuous problem has singular points where the inflow meets the outlet and at the body's corners (Appendix A.6).
  • 离散伴随的边界条件不是另外写的：它由原始格式在边界上的做法经转置得到。本页的来流处理使转置后的条件正是连续伴随的来流条件，所以加密时 ψ 连来流附近也趋于连续伴随（伴随一致）。附录 B 说明做法，并与原来的处理逐级比较。The discrete adjoint's boundary conditions are not written separately: they are the transpose of what the primal scheme does on the boundary. This page's inflow treatment transposes into exactly the continuous adjoint's inflow conditions, so under refinement ψ approaches the continuous adjoint near the inflow too (adjoint consistency). Appendix B explains how and compares level by level with the original treatment.

本页不涉及：限制器、激波、SA-neg。

Not on this page: limiters, shocks, SA-neg.

附录 AAppendix A

附录 A：连续伴随

Appendix A: the continuous adjoint

离散伴随（第 7–10 节）给出离散问题的精确导数，它在每一级网格上都由点积、前向、复数步长与差分核对。连续伴随回答另一个问题：网格加密时，离散导数是否趋于连续问题的导数。本附录从第 2、3 节的连续问题出发，写出连续伴随方程、边界条件与梯度公式，用与本页离散格式无关的 P1 有限元求解，再与两种离散伴随在第 0–4 级网格上比较。方程取自二维可压缩 RANS–SA 的一份完整耦合推导（尚未公开）；本附录把用到的每个公式都写出来，读者不需要那份推导稿。五个伴随方程保留标准 SA 的全部模型导数；这个问题特有的来流边界条件与对三个参数的梯度是本页补上的。

The discrete adjoint (Sections 7–10) gives the exact derivative of the discrete problem, checked on every mesh by the dot test, the tangent, the complex step and finite differences. The continuous adjoint answers a different question: whether the discrete derivatives approach the derivative of the continuous problem as the mesh is refined. This appendix starts from the continuous problem of Sections 2 and 3, writes out the continuous adjoint equations, boundary conditions and gradient formula, solves them by P1 finite elements that share nothing with this page's discrete schemes, and compares the result with both discrete adjoints on levels 0–4. The equations come from a full coupled derivation for 2-D compressible RANS–SA (not published yet); this appendix writes out every formula it uses, so the reader needs no access to that derivation. The five adjoint equations keep every model derivative of the standard SA; the inflow boundary conditions of this problem and the gradient with respect to the three parameters are added here.

A.1 连续问题

A.1 The continuous problem

区域 Ω 是第 0 级两圈八边形之间的多边形环。各级网格都在这同一个多边形上逐级细分，所以它的角点也属于连续问题。方程是第 2 节的定常 RANS–SA；边界条件是第 3 节的三种，n 指向区域外：

The domain Ω is the polygonal annulus between the two octagons of level 0. Every level refines this same polygon, so its corners belong to the continuous problem too. The equations are the steady RANS–SA of Section 2, and the boundary conditions the three kinds of Section 3, with n pointing out of the domain:

  • 壁面 Γw：u = v = 0，ν̃ = 0，qn = 0（绝热）；the wall Γw: u = v = 0, ν̃ = 0, qn = 0 (adiabatic);
  • 来流 Γin（u∞·n < 0 的面）：ρ = 1，u = u∞ = M√γ(cos α, sin α)，ν̃ = 3μref，qn = 0，T 自由；the inflow Γin (the faces with u∞·n < 0): ρ = 1, u = u∞ = M√γ(cos α, sin α), ν̃ = 3μref, qn = 0, T free;
  • 出口 Γout：p n − τ·n = p∞n（p∞ = 1），qn = 0，a ∂ν̃/∂n = 0。the outlet Γout: p n − τ·n = p∞n (p∞ = 1), qn = 0, a ∂ν̃/∂n = 0.
CD=eD⋅∫Γwt dsq∞,t=p n−τn,eD=(cos⁡α,sin⁡α),q∞=0.7M2

t 是流体作用在物体上的力的面密度（壁面上 n 指向物体）。三个参数 m = (α, M, μref) 经来流数据 u∞(α, M)、ν̃∞ = 3μref、方向 eD(α)、动压 q∞(M) 与粘度 μ(T) = μref·1.4T1.5/(T + 0.4) 进入问题。

t is the surface density of the force the fluid exerts on the body (on the wall n points into the body). The three parameters m = (α, M, μref) enter through the inflow data u∞(α, M), ν̃∞ = 3μref, the direction eD(α), the dynamic pressure q∞(M), and the viscosity μ(T) = μref·1.4T1.5/(T + 0.4).

A.3 边界条件

A.3 Boundary conditions

分部积分留下的边界项有两部分：𝔟f 来自四个流动方程，𝔟s 来自 SA 方程：

The integration by parts leaves boundary terms in two parts: 𝔟f from the four flow equations and 𝔟s from the SA equation:

𝔟f=un𝒜 δρ+[ρ𝒜n+ρun(β+ζu)+ζt+Zn]⋅δu+[ρcvunζ+ke∂nζ]δT+(β+ζu)⋅δt+ζ δqn
𝔟s=[unϕ+a∂nϕ−2b ϕ ∂nν~]η−ϕ δjs+Yω (nyδu−nxδv)

其中 𝒜 = λρ + β·u + ζE，js = a∂nν̃ 是 SA 的扩散通量，η = δν̃，b = cb2/σ。原始边界条件决定哪些变分为零、哪些自由；自由变分的系数必须为零，这就是伴随边界条件：

with 𝒜 = λρ + β·u + ζE, js = a∂nν̃ the SA diffusive flux, η = δν̃ and b = cb2/σ. The primal boundary conditions decide which variations vanish and which are free; the coefficients of the free ones must vanish, and that is the adjoint boundary condition:

边界boundary原始条件下的变分variations under the primal conditions伴随条件adjoint conditions
壁面wallδu = 0，η = 0，δqn = 0；δρ、δT、δt、δjs 自由，目标里有 eD·t/q∞δu = 0, η = 0, δqn = 0; δρ, δT, δt, δjs free, and the objective holds eD·t/q∞β = −eD/q∞，∂nζ = 0，φ = 0β = −eD/q∞, ∂nζ = 0, φ = 0
出口outletδt = 0，δqn = 0，δjs = 0；δρ、δu、δT、η 自由δt = 0, δqn = 0, δjs = 0; δρ, δu, δT, η free𝒜 = 0；Zn + ρun(β + ζu) + ζp∞n + Yω(ny, −nx) = 0；ke∂nζ + ρcvunζ = 0；a∂nφ + unφ = 0𝒜 = 0; Zn + ρun(β + ζu) + ζp∞n + Yω(ny, −nx) = 0; ke∂nζ + ρcvunζ = 0; a∂nφ + unφ = 0
来流inflowδρ = δu = η = 0，δqn = 0；δT、δt、δjs 自由δρ = δu = η = 0, δqn = 0; δT, δt, δjs freeβ + ζu = 0；ke∂nζ + ρcvunζ = 0；φ = 0β + ζu = 0; ke∂nζ + ρcvunζ = 0; φ = 0

逐项看壁面一行：壁面上 u = 0，所以 un = 0，δρ 的系数 un𝒜 自动为零；δu = 0、η = 0，它们的系数不起作用。δt 自由，它的系数 β + ζu = β 加上目标里的 eD/q∞，给出 β = −eD/q∞；δT 自由，系数 ke∂nζ（un = 0）给出 ∂nζ = 0；η = 0 但 ∂nη 不受约束，所以 δjs = a∂nη 自由，它在 𝔟s 里的系数 −φ 给出 φ = 0。

The wall row term by term: u = 0 on the wall, so un = 0 and the coefficient un𝒜 of δρ vanishes by itself; δu = 0 and η = 0, so their coefficients do not matter. δt is free, and its coefficient β + ζu = β plus the objective's eD/q∞ gives β = −eD/q∞; δT is free, and its coefficient ke∂nζ (un = 0) gives ∂nζ = 0; η = 0 but ∂nη is unconstrained, so δjs = a∂nη is free, and its coefficient −φ in 𝔟s gives φ = 0.

来流一行是本页补上的。若来流给定全部五个量（T 也给定），所有状态的迹都不能变，结论是 β = ζ = φ = 0。这里 T 不给定、热流为零，所以 δT 自由而 δqn = 0；∂nδu 自由，于是 δt 可以取任意值，而且与 δT 无关（给定 δT，仍可用 ∂nδu 把 δt 调成任意值）；∂nη 自由，于是 δjs 也可以。这三个自由变分在 𝔟f、𝔟s 里的系数是 β + ζu（δt）、ρcvunζ + ke∂nζ（δT）与 −φ（δjs），令它们为零就是表中的三条。ζ 满足与出口相同的 Robin 条件，β 经 β + ζu = 0 与 ζ 相连。λρ 不需要条件。伴随沿 −u 输运，所以来流边界是伴随的出口：λρ 在那里离开区域；无粘伴随在那里只接受一个条件（原始方程在来流上只有一道出射波），而粘性伴随有四个。这正是原始问题在过定出口上的情形反过来：伴随在来流边界附近有一层边界层，宽度约 ν/|un|（A.6 的图可以看到它）。

The inflow row is added here. If the inflow fixed all five variables (T too), no trace of the state could vary and the result would be β = ζ = φ = 0. Here T is not prescribed and the heat flux is zero, so δT is free and δqn = 0; ∂nδu is free, so δt can take any value, independently of δT (given δT, ∂nδu can still set δt to anything); and ∂nη is free, so δjs can too. In 𝔟f and 𝔟s the coefficients of these three free variations are β + ζu (δt), ρcvunζ + ke∂nζ (δT) and −φ (δjs); setting them to zero gives the three conditions of the table. ζ satisfies the same Robin condition as at the outlet, and β is tied to ζ by β + ζu = 0. λρ takes no condition. The adjoint is transported along −u, so the inflow is the adjoint's outlet: λρ leaves the domain there, and the inviscid adjoint accepts only one condition there (the primal has only one outgoing wave at the inflow), while the viscous adjoint has four. This is the primal problem's over-specified outlet turned around: the adjoint carries a boundary layer next to the inflow, of width about ν/|un| (visible in the figure of A.6).

A.4 梯度

A.4 The gradient

参数变化时状态 W(m) 仍满足边界条件，但来流上的数据变了：δu = ∂u∞/∂m，η = ∂ν̃∞/∂m；其余变分（δT、δt、δjs）的系数已由伴随条件置零。代入 𝔟f、𝔟s，一个伴随解给出三个导数：

As a parameter changes, the state W(m) keeps satisfying the boundary conditions, but the data on the inflow change: δu = ∂u∞/∂m and η = ∂ν̃∞/∂m, while the coefficients of the other variations (δT, δt, δjs) have been set to zero by the adjoint conditions. Put into 𝔟f and 𝔟s, one adjoint solution gives all three derivatives:

dCDdm=∂CD∂m∣W+∫Γin([ρ𝒜n+ρun(β+ζu)+ζt+Zn]⋅∂u∞∂m+a ∂nϕ ∂ν~∞∂m)ds+∫Ω(∂μe∂mCμ+∂ke∂mCk+∂a∂m∇ϕ⋅∇ν~−ϕ Qν∂ν∂m)dΩ

在来流上 φ = 0，所以 Yω 与 η 系数里含 φ 的项都消失。第一项是目标的显式导数：α 经 eD(α)，∂CD/∂α|W = eD′·F/q∞（F 是物体受的力，eD′ = (−sin α, cos α)）；M 经 q∞，∂CD/∂M|W = −2CD/M。μref 也经 t 里的粘性应力进入目标，但这一项与壁面边界项 (β + ζu)·δt 在 β = −eD/q∞ 时正好抵消（来流上 β + ζu = 0 让同类的项为零，出口的牵引力是给定值），所以对 μref 只剩最后的体积分，其中的偏导数在固定状态下取。体积分只对 μref 非零：α 与 M 只经来流速度进入问题。

On the inflow φ = 0, so Yω and the terms with φ in η's coefficient drop out. The first term is the objective's explicit derivative: α enters through eD(α), ∂CD/∂α|W = eD′·F/q∞ (F the force on the body, eD′ = (−sin α, cos α)); M through q∞, ∂CD/∂M|W = −2CD/M. μref also enters the objective through the viscous stress in t, but that term cancels exactly against the wall's boundary term (β + ζu)·δt at β = −eD/q∞ (on the inflow β + ζu = 0 removes the same kind of term, and the outlet's traction is prescribed), so for μref only the last volume integral remains, with its partial derivatives taken at a fixed state. The volume integral is non-zero for μref only: α and M enter the problem only through the inflow velocity.

A.5 离散：P1 有限元

A.5 Discretisation: P1 finite elements

连续伴随用与第 2–10 节无关的办法求解：每一级网格的四边形沿一条对角线分成两个三角形，五个伴随场都取连续分片线性函数（P1），用 Galerkin 弱形式；方程的系数取格点格式在同一级网格上收敛解的 P1 插值。

The continuous adjoint is solved by a method unrelated to Sections 2–10: every quadrilateral of a level is split into two triangles along a diagonal, the five adjoint fields are continuous and piecewise linear (P1), and the weak form is Galerkin; the coefficients come from the P1 interpolant of the node scheme's converged solution on the same level.

  • 二阶项（∇·Z、∇·(ke∇ζ)、∇·(a∇φ)、∇·(φ∇ν̃)）与涡量项 𝒱 分部积分到试函数上，所以只用到原始解的一阶导数，sgn ω 的跳跃也精确保留；the second-order terms (∇·Z, ∇·(ke∇ζ), ∇·(a∇φ), ∇·(φ∇ν̃)) and the vorticity term 𝒱 are integrated by parts onto the test function, so only first derivatives of the primal solution appear, and the jump of sgn ω is kept exactly;
  • 稳定化：内部边上的连续内罚 ciphF2 s∫F[∂nw][∂nλ] ds（λρ、β、ζ 取 s = |u·n| + c，φ 取 s = |u·n|，cip = 0.05）。光滑解的法向导数在边上没有跳跃，所以这一项是相容的；stabilisation: the continuous interior penalty ciphF2 s∫F[∂nw][∂nλ] ds on the interior edges (s = |u·n| + c for λρ, β, ζ and s = |u·n| for φ, cip = 0.05). A smooth solution's normal derivative has no jump across an edge, so this term is consistent;
  • 边界：强条件在节点上直接替换方程——壁面 β = −eD/q∞、φ = 0；来流 β + ζu = 0、φ = 0；出口 𝒜 = 0（替换 λρ 的方程）。自然条件进入弱形式：出口的动量与能量 Robin 项，来流的能量 Robin 项；boundaries: the strong conditions replace equations at the nodes: β = −eD/q∞ and φ = 0 on the wall, β + ζu = 0 and φ = 0 on the inflow, and 𝒜 = 0 on the outlet (replacing λρ's equation). The natural conditions enter the weak form: the outlet's momentum and energy Robin terms, and the inflow's energy Robin term;
  • 梯度里的 Zn 与 a∂nφ 不从 λ 的离散边界导数求，而是变分地取：把 ∂u∞/∂m、∂ν̃∞/∂m 放在来流节点上的试函数代入未加强条件的弱形式；the Zn and a∂nφ of the gradient are not taken from the discrete λ's derivative on the boundary but variationally: a test function carrying ∂u∞/∂m and ∂ν̃∞/∂m at the inflow nodes is put into the weak form before the strong conditions are imposed;
  • 线性方程组用稀疏 LU 直接求解。有限体积格式的 A 与 AT 都没有用到——这是两种伴随的比较有意义的前提。the linear system is solved directly by sparse LU. Neither the finite-volume schemes' A nor AT is used anywhere: that is what makes the comparison of the two adjoints meaningful.

The relative difference between the derivatives from the continuous adjoint and from this page's (cell) discrete adjoint (over the cell value, levels 1, 2, 3, 4): α −330.7% → −65.0% → −18.3% → −6.8%; M 295.5% → 54.2% → 12.2% → 2.7%; μref 63.7% → 19.6% → 6.2% → 2.7%. The ratios between neighbouring levels: α 0.20, 0.28, 0.37; M 0.18, 0.22, 0.22; μref 0.31, 0.32, 0.43. From level 1 to level 4 the three differences shrink by factors of 49, 109, 24, but the ratio between neighbouring levels does not settle at a quarter (h2); the last step is slower than the one before for α, μref, while for M the last step is the fastest. On level 4 the node scheme's discrete adjoint gives −1.405, −12.674, 219.0, this page's (cell) −1.326, −12.450, 214.6. The two schemes' relative differences from the continuous adjoint on level 4: cell α 6.8%, M 2.7%, μref 2.7%, node α 0.8%, M 4.4%, μref 0.6%; the cell scheme lies further away for α, μref and closer for M. The continuous adjoint takes its coefficients from the node scheme's solution, which the node discrete adjoint shares; the cell scheme's comparison also carries the difference between the two schemes' primal solutions (CD on level 4: cell 6.4138, node 6.4560), and on the two side faces its row of cells along the boundary carries too little density (Appendix B.6). Why the ratio cannot settle at a quarter lies in the continuous problem itself: at the two octagon vertices where the inflow meets the outlet, the velocity's Dirichlet condition meets the traction condition, and on the outlet side the velocity deviation |u − u∞| varies as a power of the distance to the vertex (fitted at the two junctions on level 4: powers 0.65, 0.67, below 1), so the solution's gradient is unbounded there; the corners of the body's octagon are singular points too. Near these points neither the primal solution nor the adjoint is smooth, and every discretisation converges there only slowly. Besides, the continuous adjoint carries the inflow boundary layer of A.3, which the P1 solution has to resolve on the mesh.

The adjoint fields themselves. Row i of the cell scheme's residual is the integral of the conservative residual over cell i, and this page's Lagrangian CD + ψTR has the sign of A.2's ℒ, so ψi approximates the continuous adjoint's multipliers of the conservative equations at xi (A.2). The continuous adjoint is its P1 interpolant at the cell centres, and every cell takes part. Over the cells farther than 0.8 from the inflow, the relative RMS difference of the two:

动量与 ν̃ 的乘子逐级靠近（第 3→4 级之比 0.31–0.58）；质量与能量的乘子收敛得慢一些，它们与来流边界层和出口的 𝒜 = 0 耦合在一起。靠近来流，连续伴随有 A.3 所说的边界层（ζ 与 λρ 向来流陡升；附录 B.6 的线性化给出它在正面的厚度约 0.15–0.16）。本页的来流取边界状态的物理通量，转置后给出的正是 A.3 的来流条件，这就是伴随一致（附录 B.4）。但贴边界那一排单元的原始解有偏差（附录 B.6），来流 0.3 以内 ψρ 的相对均方根差是 137% → 155% → 101%，到最后一级才开始下降。

The multipliers of momentum and ν̃ approach each other level by level (a ratio of 0.31–0.58 from level 3 to 4); those of mass and energy converge more slowly, being coupled to the inflow layer and to the outlet's 𝒜 = 0. Near the inflow the continuous adjoint has the boundary layer of A.3 (ζ and λρ climb steeply towards the inflow; the linearisation of Appendix B.6 gives it a thickness of about 0.15–0.16 on the front faces). This page's inflow takes the physical flux of the boundary state, whose transpose gives exactly the inflow conditions of A.3: adjoint consistency (Appendix B.4). But the row of cells along the boundary carries a biased primal solution (Appendix B.6), and within 0.3 of the inflow the relative RMS difference of ψρ is 137% → 155% → 101%, starting to fall only on the last level.

结论：离散伴随在每一级都是离散问题的精确导数（第 12、13 节）；连续伴随是对连续问题导数的另一种近似。从第 1 级到第 4 级，两者的差缩小到原来的 1/49、1/109、1/24（α、M、μref）：这是数值上的证据，说明本页的两种离散格式与这个连续问题相容，它们的导数趋于同一个连续灵敏度。

The conclusion: on every level the discrete adjoint is the exact derivative of the discrete problem (Sections 12 and 13), and the continuous adjoint is another approximation of the continuous problem's derivative. From level 1 to level 4 the difference between them shrinks by factors of 49, 109, 24 (α, M, μref): numerical evidence that this page's two discrete schemes are consistent with this continuous problem and that their derivatives approach the same continuous sensitivity.

范围：这里比较的是同一个连续问题（包括它的角点）的几种近似，结论是数值上的。它不证明连续问题解的存在唯一与伴随的正则性；在交界点与角点附近，伴随与原始解一样有奇性，在 ω = 0、r0 = 10 或 S̃ 分支交界处模型本身不可微，那里需要单侧导数。连续伴随的系数取自格点格式的解，所以它检验的是伴随方程、边界条件与梯度公式，不单独检验原始解。

Scope: what is compared here are several approximations of the same continuous problem (its corners included), and the conclusion is numerical. It does not prove existence and uniqueness for the continuous problem or the regularity of its adjoint; near the junctions and the corners the adjoint is singular like the primal solution, and where ω = 0, r0 = 10 or the two branches of S̃ meet the model itself is not differentiable and needs one-sided derivatives. The continuous adjoint takes its coefficients from the node scheme's solution, so it tests the adjoint equations, boundary conditions and gradient formula, not the primal solution on its own.

附录 BAppendix B

附录 B：伴随一致性

Appendix B: adjoint consistency

本页的来流处理是伴随一致的；原来的版本只在来流边界上与本页不同。本附录说明两者差在哪里、为什么这一点差别决定离散伴随在来流附近趋于什么，并在同一组网格上比较两者。

This page's inflow treatment is adjoint-consistent; the original version differs from it on the inflow boundary only. This appendix explains the difference, why it decides what the discrete adjoint approaches near the inflow, and compares the two on the same meshes.

B.1 什么是伴随一致

B.1 What adjoint consistency means

两种版本的离散伴随 ψ 都满足 ATψ = −g，都是各自离散问题的精确导数（第 7–13 节的检验对两者都成立）。伴随一致性（也叫对偶一致性）问的是另一件事：把 ATψ = −g 本身看作一个离散格式，它是不是连续伴随方程连同边界条件的相容离散。若是，加密时 ψ 逐点趋于连续伴随 λ（换算到守恒方程的乘子，附录 A.2），边界附近也一样；若不是，ψ 在区域内部仍可以趋于 λ，在边界附近却趋于另一个问题的解。两种版本的区域内部格式、壁面与出口完全相同，连续问题也相同（附录 A.1），所以差别只可能来自来流边界。

The discrete adjoints ψ of both versions satisfy ATψ = −g and are the exact derivatives of their discrete problems (the checks of Sections 7–13 hold for both). Adjoint consistency (also called dual consistency) asks something else: read ATψ = −g itself as a discrete scheme; is it a consistent discretisation of the continuous adjoint equations together with their boundary conditions? If it is, ψ approaches the continuous adjoint λ (mapped to the multipliers of the conservative equations, Appendix A.2) point by point under refinement, next to the boundary as well; if it is not, ψ can still approach λ inside the domain, but next to the boundary it approaches the solution of a different problem. The two versions share the interior scheme, the wall and the outlet, and the continuous problem (Appendix A.1), so any difference comes from the inflow boundary.

B.2 离散伴随的边界条件从哪里来

B.2 Where the discrete adjoint's boundary conditions come from

离散伴随的边界条件不是另外写的：AT 是原始格式的转置，边界上的做法经转置自动变成伴随的边界条件。格心格式没有被替换的行，只有一条规则：

The discrete adjoint's boundary conditions are not written separately: AT is the transpose of the primal scheme, and what the scheme does on the boundary turns into the adjoint's boundary conditions by that transpose. The cell scheme has no replaced rows, so one rule does it:

  • 边界通量依赖的状态分量。边界面的通量 Fbc 读哪些状态分量，AT 在这些分量的列上就多出 (∂Fbc/∂U)Tψ。连续问题在来流上的通量只经温度 T 和牵引力、SA 扩散通量这些自由的量依赖解：ρ、u、ν̃ 是给定值。离散通量若还依赖单元的 ρ、u 或 ν̃，转置后就多出连续伴随没有的边界项。The state components a boundary flux reads. Whatever state components the boundary face's flux Fbc reads, AT receives (∂Fbc/∂U)Tψ in those columns. The continuous inflow flux depends on the solution only through the temperature T and the free quantities traction and SA diffusive flux: ρ, u and ν̃ are given. If the discrete flux also reads the cell's ρ, u or ν̃, its transpose carries boundary terms the continuous adjoint does not have.

连续伴随在来流上要满足的是附录 A.3 的三条，λρ 不需要条件：伴随沿 −u 输运，来流边界是 λρ 离开区域的地方。换算到守恒方程的乘子（A.2）：ψρ ↔ λρ − ν̃φ/ρ，ψρu ↔ β，ψρE ↔ ζ，ψρν̃ ↔ φ/ρ。

What the continuous adjoint has to satisfy on the inflow are the three conditions of Appendix A.3, and λρ takes none: the adjoint is transported along −u, and the inflow is where λρ leaves the domain. In the multipliers of the conservative equations (A.2): ψρ ↔ λρ − ν̃φ/ρ, ψρu ↔ β, ψρE ↔ ζ, ψρν̃ ↔ φ/ρ.

β+ζu=0,ke ∂nζ+ρcvunζ=0,ϕ=0

B.3 原来的来流处理为什么伴随不一致

B.3 Why the original inflow treatment is adjoint-inconsistent

格心格式原来在来流面上取 Roe 通量对虚拟状态 Wg = (ρ∞, u∞, v∞, Tf, ν̃∞)：

The cell scheme originally took, on an inflow face, the Roe flux against the ghost state Wg = (ρ∞, u∞, v∞, Tf, ν̃∞):

Fbc=12(F(Wf)+F(Wg))⋅n−12∣J~c∣ (Ug−Uf)∣n∣

面状态 Wf 是单元自己的重构，所以 Fbc 依赖单元状态的全部五个分量，不只是 T：质量通量里有 ½ρfuf·n，熵波与声波的耗散也随单元的 ρ、u 变。按 B.2 的规则，来流单元的质量、动量与 ν̃ 列上多出边界项；质量列上的那一项给 λρ 加了一个连续伴随没有的边界关系，正是在伴随的出口多给了条件。耗散项对单元状态的导数是 ½|J̃c||n|，大小只随面积变，所以这一项加密也不会消失。

The face state Wf is the cell's own reconstruction, so Fbc depends on all five components of the cell state, not on T alone: the mass flux holds ½ρfuf·n, and the dissipation of the entropy and acoustic waves moves with the cell's ρ and u as well. By the rule of B.2 the mass, momentum and ν̃ columns of an inflow cell receive boundary terms; the one in the mass column gives λρ a boundary relation the continuous adjoint does not have: a condition too many at the adjoint's outlet. The dissipation's derivative with respect to the cell state is ½|J̃c||n|, which changes with the face area only, so refinement does not remove this term.

原始解同样受影响，而且在本页的网格上并不小。两个侧面上贴边界那一排带来流面的单元，原处理的 ρ 最低 0.967、0.965、0.967，一致的版本 0.920、0.911、0.909（第 2、3、4 级），加密都不收敛到同一个值；第 4 级的阻力 6.5991 与 6.4138 相差 2.9%，而格点格式的两种处理只差 0.25%（6.4399 与 6.4560）。按理，耗散项正比于面状态与虚拟状态之差，面状态若趋于边界上的状态，它也会趋于零；但来流边界上有一层厚约 0.002–0.007 的粘性子层（B.6），而第 4 级网格在来流边界上的网格尺寸约 0.045，分辨不了它，所以在本页的网格上看不到这个极限。

The primal solution is affected too, and on this page's meshes not by little. On the two side faces, the row of cells with an inflow face drops to ρ = 0.967, 0.965, 0.967 in the original and 0.920, 0.911, 0.909 in the consistent version (levels 2, 3, 4), and refinement does not bring them together; on level 4 the drag is 6.5991 against 6.4138, 2.9% apart, while the node scheme's two treatments differ by only 0.25% (6.4399 and 6.4560). In principle the dissipation is proportional to the difference between the face state and the ghost state and would go to zero if the face state approached the state on the boundary; but the inflow boundary carries a viscous sublayer about 0.002–0.007 thick (B.6), and on level 4 the mesh size at the inflow boundary is about 0.045, which cannot resolve it, so this limit is not reached on this page's meshes.

B.4 伴随一致的来流处理

B.4 The adjoint-consistent inflow treatment

一致的版本只换对流通量：来流面上取边界状态 Wbc = (ρ∞, u∞, v∞, Tf, ν̃∞) 的物理通量 F(Wbc)·n。它只经 Tf 依赖单元，按 B.2 的规则只有温度方向上有边界项；质量通量是给定值，λρ 不受约束。这与 Hartmann（2007）对间断 Galerkin 格式得出的要求相同：边界上用边界状态的物理通量，而不是数值通量。粘性部分不变：面点上 u、ν̃ 取来流值的两点差分，它的转置在同一个面上把 ψρu + u∞ψρE 与 ψρν̃ 推向零，即 β + ζu = 0 与 φ = 0；能量里的功 u∞·τn 与动量用同一个 τn，否则 β + ζu 这个组合凑不起来。温度方向上，动量里的压力 ρ∞Tfn 与能量里的 ρ∞cpTfun 在 β = −ζu 时合成 ρ∞cvunζ，面上没有热流，于是得到 Robin 条件。

The consistent version changes the convective flux only: an inflow face takes the physical flux F(Wbc)·n of the boundary state Wbc = (ρ∞, u∞, v∞, Tf, ν̃∞). It reads the cell through Tf alone, so by the rule of B.2 the only boundary term is in the temperature direction; the mass flux is given, and λρ is left free. This is the requirement Hartmann (2007) found for discontinuous Galerkin schemes: on the boundary, the physical flux of the boundary state rather than a numerical flux. The viscous part is unchanged: the two-point difference to u and ν̃ at the face point, whose transpose drives ψρu + u∞ψρE and ψρν̃ to zero on the same face, i.e. β + ζu = 0 and φ = 0; the work u∞·τn in the energy row uses the momentum's own τn, without which the combination β + ζu could not form. In the temperature direction the pressure ρ∞Tfn in the momentum and ρ∞cpTfun in the energy combine at β = −ζu into ρ∞cvunζ, and with no heat flux through the face this is the Robin condition.

图 B.1 把附录 B 的转置规则落到本页的一个来流面上：对流通量对面状态 Wf = (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃) 的 Jacobian 有哪些非零列，转置后的边界项就落在哪些方向。原来的处理有 5 列非零（ρ、u、v、T、ν̃），伴随一致的处理只有 1 列（T）。粘性部分两种处理相同，不在图里。

Figure B.1 applies Appendix B's transpose rule to one inflow face of this page: the non-zero columns of the convective flux's Jacobian with respect to the face state Wf = (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃) are the directions in which the transposed boundary terms land. The original treatment has 5 non-zero columns (ρ, u, v, T, ν̃), the adjoint-consistent one 1 (T). The viscous part is the same in both treatments and is not in the figure.

一致的版本到第 3→4 级开始下降（之比 ψρ 0.65、ψρE 0.61；ψρ 137%→155%→101%），原来的版本不降（204%→273%→251%）。格心格式在来流附近误差大、下降也晚：两个侧面上来流几乎与边界平行，贴边界的那一排单元的解有偏差（B.6），而连续伴随在那里的层又最厚（约 0.31–0.47）。下图沿 180° 网格线看：一致版本的 ψ 跟着连续伴随的层走；原来的版本也有这一层，但强了约 3.1 倍（离来流最近的单元上 ψρ 与 λ 之比）。

The consistent version starts to fall from level 3 to 4 (ratios 0.65 for ψρ and 0.61 for ψρE; ψρ 137%→155%→101%), the original does not (204%→273%→251%). The cell scheme's error next to the inflow is large and falls late: on the two side faces the inflow runs almost along the boundary and the row of cells along it carries a biased solution (B.6), where the continuous adjoint's layer is also thickest (about 0.31–0.47). The figure below looks along the 180° mesh line: the consistent ψ follows the continuous adjoint's layer; the original has the layer too, but about 3.1 times too strong (the ratio of ψρ to λ in the cell nearest the inflow).

伴随一致性管的是 ψ 在边界附近趋于什么，不直接决定导数误差的大小：导数误差还来自原始解本身、交界点与角点的奇性（附录 A.6）。格心格式上一致的版本的导数从更远处趋近连续伴随的导数（B.6 的侧面偏差），逐级缩小。

Adjoint consistency governs what ψ approaches next to the boundary; it does not by itself set the size of the derivative's error, which also comes from the primal solution and from the singular points at the junctions and the corners (Appendix A.6). On the cell scheme the consistent version's derivatives approach the continuous adjoint's from further away (the side-face bias of B.6), shrinking level by level.

B.6 两个侧面：来流几乎与边界平行

B.6 The two side faces: inflow almost along the boundary

远场八边形上的四个来流面并不一样：正面（135°–225°）|u∞·n| = 0.210–0.226，两个侧面（90°–135°、225°–270°）只有 0.071–0.109。侧面上两种版本的原始解不同。格心格式上，贴边界的一排三角形（带来流面的与只以顶点碰到边界的相间）在一致的版本里密度交替：带来流面的单元 ρ 最低 0.920、0.911、0.909（第 2、3、4 级），加密不减；原处理的 Roe 耗散把它拉近 ρ∞（0.967、0.965、0.967）。正面上两者都在 1 的 0.6% 以内。这些单元的 ρ 只经质量通量 ρ∞u∞·n 与边界相连，|u∞·n| 小时这一联系弱，而贴边界单元的最小二乘梯度只有两个邻居。偏差集中在这一排：第 4 级上与格点解的 ρ 之差，带来流面的单元最大 0.056，同一排只以顶点碰到边界的单元 0.015，再往里（到 0.3）0.004。

The four inflow faces of the far octagon are not alike: on the front (135°–225°) |u∞·n| = 0.210–0.226, on the two side faces (90°–135° and 225°–270°) only 0.071–0.109. On the side faces the two versions' primal solutions differ. On the cell scheme, the row of triangles along the boundary (those with an inflow face alternating with those that touch the boundary at a vertex only) carries an alternating density in the consistent version: the cells with an inflow face drop to ρ = 0.920, 0.911, 0.909 (levels 2, 3, 4), and refinement does not reduce it; the original's Roe dissipation pulls them toward ρ∞ (0.967, 0.965, 0.967). On the front both stay within 0.6% of 1. These cells' ρ is tied to the boundary only through the mass flux ρ∞u∞·n, a weak tie where |u∞·n| is small, and a boundary cell's least-squares gradient has only two neighbours. The bias sits in this row: on level 4 the ρ differs from the node solution's by at most 0.056 in the cells with an inflow face, 0.015 in the cells of the same row that touch the boundary at a vertex, and 0.004 further in (up to 0.3).

原因在连续问题里：把定常 Navier–Stokes 方程沿来流边界的法向线性化，亚声速来流上恰有一个离开边界衰减的粘性模态，厚度约 4μe|un|/(3p)：本页的数值是侧面 0.0022–0.0034、正面 0.0066–0.0071。在这一层里 ρ 变化而 ρun 与 T 几乎不变；本页任何一级网格都分辨不了它（最细的网格第 4 级，贴来流边界的第一排节点离边界 0.045）。于是层外的解看到的边界条件取决于离散怎样跨过这一层：一致的版本只给跨层不变的质量通量；原处理的 Roe 通量还经熵波把面上的 ρ 拉向 ρ∞。同一个线性化的另一个模态朝区域内增长，厚度 0.15–0.47：它就是连续伴随在来流边界上的那一层（A.3）。附录 A 的连续伴随按光滑解推导，没有这一薄层；两种版本都在同一组网格上与它比较，结论只针对这些网格上的解与伴随。

The cause is in the continuous problem: linearise the steady Navier–Stokes equations along the normal of the inflow boundary, and a subsonic inflow has exactly one viscous mode that decays away from the boundary, of thickness about 4μe|un|/(3p): here 0.0022–0.0034 on the side faces and 0.0066–0.0071 on the front. Across this layer ρ changes while ρun and T stay nearly constant, and no mesh of this page resolves it (on the finest mesh, level 4, the first row of nodes lies 0.045 from the inflow boundary). So what boundary condition the solution outside the layer sees depends on how the discretisation steps across it: the consistent version gives only the mass flux, which does not change across the layer; the original's Roe flux also pulls the face's ρ toward ρ∞ through the entropy wave. The same linearisation's other mode grows into the domain, with thickness 0.15–0.47: it is the continuous adjoint's layer at the inflow boundary (A.3). The continuous adjoint of Appendix A is derived for a smooth solution and has no thin layer; both versions are compared with it on the same meshes, and the conclusions are about the solutions and adjoints on these meshes.

参考：R. Hartmann, Adjoint consistency analysis of discontinuous Galerkin discretizations, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 45 (2007) 2671–2696。伴随一致性是 h → 0 的性质；两种版本在每一级网格上都给出离散问题的精确导数，本页前面各节的点积、前向、复数步长与差分检验对两者都成立。

Reference: R. Hartmann, Adjoint consistency analysis of discontinuous Galerkin discretizations, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 45 (2007) 2671–2696. Adjoint consistency is a property of the limit h → 0; on every mesh both versions give the exact derivative of their discrete problem, and the dot-product, tangent, complex-step and finite-difference checks of this page's earlier sections hold for both.
